chapters.title: Chapter 170: Divine Palace Sect
paragraphs: "Remember, when we are inside the Sect, or even outside but not in private, you must always call me Master. I am your woman, but since you are not the strongest yet, I don’t want people plotting against you if they know you are my man," Saintess Selene said to Kent, who was now riding inside a carriage with Unity, Lilian, and Elsa.

After making her his woman, they spent close to 14 days together inside the tower. Of course, not all the time was spent being intimate; Kent spent most of it talking to her and getting to know her better.
In the end, she managed to help him become a Level 8 Grandmaster. This was more than enough for him, considering he has undistributed stat points he can use later.
His other three ladies sacrificed their time with him so he could spend it with his master. Now that they were done, they decided to go back to the Sect.
Lilian is already an inner disciple at the Mage Gate, so she can come and go as she pleases. She had been on vacation the last time when she was poisoned.
Even so, she still had about a week left before she needed to return. However, since Kent and the others were going, she decided to leave with them.
Unity would also be joining the Sect using the token of privilege. This would allow her to take the inner disciple exams and join the Archer Gate.
As for Elsa, she also wanted to join, but since new disciple recruitments were over, she was counting on Saintess Selene to do something for her.
"I will listen to you, Master, and don’t worry. I prefer calling you Master, so I won’t make any mistakes."
Saintess Selene blushed slightly but didn’t comment on Kent’s cheekiness.

"So, about Elsa—you said there might be a way for her to enter. Care to explain?" Kent asked. Over the past fourteen days, he had spoken with his master and found out there might be a way, but Saintess Selene wasn’t sure it was viable.𝓯𝙧𝙚𝒆𝙬𝙚𝒃𝙣𝙤𝒗𝓮𝓵.𝙘𝙤𝙢

"There is indeed a way; however, I’m not sure it’s something she can handle." She paused and then continued, "The Sect has a rule called the Battle of Equals. In this case, if someone wants to join the Sect, they must challenge someone of equal standing.
"Of course, they say that, but in reality, this Battle of Equals is against someone like me. My name isn’t on the equals chart, but there are others like me with their names on it.
"She must select one at random, and if she manages to win, her name will replace the one she defeated, automatically making her a Core Disciple like me."
"Wait, you’re also a disciple?" Kent was taken aback. He thought his master might be an elder or someone of higher rank.
"Wait, you thought I was an elder all this time?" she asked with an amused expression.

"Yeah. I thought someone with your status would be an elder. I mean, you’re like 100 years old, right?" Kent asked. He already knew her age, having used the tower to check, but he wanted to tease her.

"You’re really funny, Kent. I’m not a hundred years old, and no, I’m not at the stage where I can become an elder," Selene replied with a slight smile. "Inside the Sect, there are outer, inner, and core disciples.

"However, outside these three—or more accurately, within the core disciples—there is another title or rank known as Saints or Saintesses. This rank is perhaps even more powerful than an elder or even a vice army general.
"I am a Sword Saintess due to my achievements. I earned this title because I won the Continent Decade Sword Competition about 30 years ago.
"I’m not an elder but a disciple. It’s just that my status is a bit special within the Sect, and for the record, I’m only 69 years old."

"And if you are wondering why I was still a Sage when I met you despite leaving for close to seven decades, it was because my spirit root is just silver grade. This means my talent in cultivation is rather weak compared to my sister, Neomi."
She sighed, knowing she had only managed to break through because of the Yin Pool and the dense spiritual qi in the tower.
"You don’t have to worry. I will help you upgrade this to the supreme stage soon enough. For now, focus on using the technique Vexthra gave you. I will handle the rest."
Saintess Selene nodded with a small smile.
"So, aside from you and your sister, are there other Saints or Saintesses in the sect?" Kent asked.

"Yes. There is a Saintess at the Archer Gate and another Saintess in the Mage Gate. As for the Saint, he entered the Ancient Battlefield of Parting ten years ago and hasn’t returned yet, but he is still alive."
"I see. Then can I know when the next Continent Decade Sword Competition will happen again?" Kent asked. If he became a Saint with the sword, he could perhaps have more authority to do more.
He can also officially declare Saintess Selene as his woman and wouldn’t face any backlash. Of course, he can also become the Perfect Alchemist, which is equally classic.
"It will happen a year from now. But you must know, this is a competition between the best of the best. You must at least be ready to face some danger.

"The least cultivation base when I participated was Level 2 Root Saint, but now they are taking Level 5 Root Sages, and it can go up to Level 4 Root Great Sage. So, be ready and careful, as the death rate in this competition is very high."
"I will be ready, Master. No need to look worried. With you, I will soon become a Saint, and after that, a Sage. No need to look sad."
"We are here." Just as Kent and his women were conversing, the carriage stopped in front of a large gate made of pure gold.
The towering pillars stretched meters high, each embedded with countless formations. Kent, using his enchanted eyes, managed to perceive most of these formations, and for a moment, he nearly tripped.
"This place is well protected," Kent commented as they stepped out of the carriage, immediately catching everyone’s attention.
This was especially true for Elsa, Kent, and Saintess Selene. Many recognized Selene as she was one of the backbones of the Althea Kingdom and the Divine Palace Sect.
"This is the top sect in the kingdom, so of course, it will be well protected," Saintess Selene remarked as they began walking toward the guards at the entrance.
"Open the gate!" one guard shouted. "The Sword Saintess has returned!"
The moment he said that, Kent began hearing the sound of boots hitting the floor. He used his Divine Sense along with his enchanted eyes and saw a line of 100 guards running toward the gate.
As soon as the gate opened, he saw the guards form a perfect line, creating a pathway. Or, more accurately, they created a space for the Saintess to pass.
Kent observed all this and smiled.
’Looks like you’re a big shot here, my love. I wonder how they would react if they found out you were calling me Master just a few hours ago while bent in doggy posture on my bed.’
Saintess Selene, hearing Kent’s words in her mind, nearly tripped. Luckily, Elsa was beside her. She grabbed her hand and turned to glare at Kent.
Meanwhile, Vexthra was rolling on her bed, laughing since Kent ensured all his women heard his comment.

Of course, Kent knew more, and for a moment, he realized that if he didn’t tread carefully, he would be doomed before he knew it.
"Greetings, Gate Master Mara," Selene said, bowing slightly. Unity, Liliana, and Elsa followed suit, but not Kent.
It wasn’t because he didn’t want to; he simply couldn’t move his body. Something—or someone—had locked him down, and he wasn’t about to use his aura to break free.
"Who are you?" Gate Master Mara asked, raising a finger to stop the worried Saintess from answering. It was clear she hadn’t expected this outcome.
"I should be the one asking that, don’t you think?" Kent replied, knowing this wasn’t how he had envisioned his first day in the sect.
"But since you want to know, I am Kent. Kent Madson," he said with a small smile, reassuring his master that he was okay.
However, perhaps that was a mistake, as the next second, the aura suppressing him intensified, and blood began flowing from his nose.
Saintess Selene and his other ladies wanted to intervene, but he used the connection between them to stop them from entering his mess.
It was clearly a test, considering there was no killing intent in her aura. It seemed more like she was testing his resistance against pressure.
But he wasn’t about to lose face. His perverted side had already scanned the Gate Master, and he knew she was someone who he could play with or, more accurately, she had things Kent could play with.
Both her chest and backside couldn’t be ignored.
Gate Master Mara arrived with five others, and from what Kent could tell, they were her disciples in a way, considering they were looking at him with smug expressions.
It was as if they knew something, and upon seeing the bleeding Kent, they started smiling inwardly. Of course, Kent scoffed and then raised his hand.
He looked at the Gate Master and smiled before he snapped his fingers.
The next second, the aura surrounding him was cut off.
It was as if nothing had happened from the start. He dried his nose and looked toward Gate Master Mara.
"Thank you for the welcome, Gate Master, but I’m afraid you might want to use a much stronger aura next time. No hard feelings, though."
Kent smirked, watching the shocked expression flash across Gate Master Mara’s face.
As for the five behind her, they all wore shocked expressions. Even Saintess Selene shared the same reaction. Why?
Kent had just rendered the aura of a Root Transcendent useless. Nobody understood how he did it. In fact, Gate Master Mara wanted to ask but held back, knowing it would be rude.
In reality, Kent had used a skill he received when Selene joined his harem. It was a skill called [Rule Breaker].
It was a divine skill with a single, straightforward function. The description read: "Once a day, you can break the rule of anyone who attacks you."

The description was simple yet incredibly powerful. Essentially, Kent could use this skill once per day to negate any rule or effect. If he were poisoned, he could use the skill to nullify the poison.

If he were stabbed in the heart, he could break the attack. It functioned like an [undo] ability. However, once he used it, the person it was used against would be unable to harm him for the rest of the day.
Of course, if a new attacker appeared, Kent would have to rely on his own abilities to defend himself. But for a day, he had a guaranteed way to escape death once.
He used it against Gate Master Mara, and at the moment, she was trying to test him again, but it wasn’t working.
All attempts she made bore no fruit. She was practically rendered useless in front of Kent.

"It won’t work, Gate Master. But since you and I are practically best friends now, why don’t we get to know each other more? Like I said, I am Kent, and even though you already knew, I am the one and only disciple of Sword Saintess Selene. Nice meeting you."
Kent extended his hand for a handshake.

The five behind the Gate Master wanted to protest, knowing what Kent was doing was rude. Even Saintess Selene wanted to stop him, but she froze when she saw the Gate Master smile and take Kent’s handshake.
"Nice meeting you, Kent. I am Gate Master Mara... Well, I am the master of the sword gate, but since, like you said, we are best friends, you can just call me Mara or Marr."
Kent nodded with a smile, shocking everyone who witnessed this.
Inwardly, though, Kent was freaking out. That was because the smile Mara gave him wasn’t friendly at all. He saw it, and then it happened.

She turned to Saintess Selene. "Congratulations on finally finding a disciple; however, because your disciple is now my friend, he will have to go through the trial of the sword. If he passes, the sect will recognize him as your disciple; else, he will be crippled for disrespecting a Gate Master."
Saintess Selene turned pale upon hearing that. In fact, she had expected this the moment she saw the Gate Master appear. Why? It was because the Gate Master was someone with a unique set of eyes.
In the human continent, and perhaps the entire world, she is the only one with that sight: [The Sword Eye.]
This eye allows her to see the true nature of people, and she sees something that enrages her.
She saw her former disciple was no longer a virgin, and, tracking her yin essence, she saw it all over Kent. From the start, she had wanted to kill Kent for defiling her innocent former disciple.
But she couldn’t outright do it...So she went for the next best thing. However, she picked the wrong thing...
[Master, this is your chance to become famous.]
Of course, Kent was smiling at that very moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 172: Those Known as Monsters
paragraphs: A few weeks ago, when Kent awakened the tower and was going through the messages, he discovered the true nature of his Primordial Genesis Sword Art.
It was at that very moment he made plans to obtain one for his master, whom he was trying to seduce at the time.
Thankfully, being the son of the universe who has access to the Universe Pool, he was offered a way to unlock the 5th sword path.
The quest required him to challenge 100 swordsmen in the Sword Gate of the Divine Palace Sect. Those were the details, and he had to win every single challenge.
Since then, he had kept it in the back of his mind, planning to undertake the quest as soon as he entered the sect with his master.
But who would have thought that a challenge would land in his lap like a morning coffee when he stepped through the sect’s doors?
The sect—or more specifically, the Sword Gate of the sect—had a trial called the Trial of the Sword. It was the most difficult trial in the entire sect, mainly due to its harsh conditions.

The challenge was a duel-style trial where Kent had to face 50 people from the Sword Gate and win against all of them within five days. In fact, if he lost even one duel, the punishment dictated that he would be crippled.
This trial was reserved for those who had committed a grave offense that could not be easily forgiven.
However, since its inception, only three people have attempted the trial, and all were crippled before they could win their fourth match.

"Master, please, isn’t this a bit harsh?" Saintess Selene, who had turned pale upon hearing the punishment imposed on Kent, shouted at the Gate Master, appealing to their past relationship as master and disciple.
"Harsh? Yes, but he deserves it for being arrogant," Gate Master Mara said, though her tone betrayed a hint of doubt in her own words.
"Master, please," Saintess Selene pleaded again, but the Gate Master ignored her. She turned to Kent, who was smiling calmly back at her.

"Two days from now, you will enter the Trial of the Sword, where you will face 50 Sword Masters and Grandmasters. You must win all 50 duels within five days, or you will be crippled and expelled as a disciple of the Sword Saintess," Gate Master Mara declared firmly.
Kent turned to the pale Saintess and chuckled.
"Sorry, but I don’t think this is fair," Kent said, making Gate Master Mara shrug indifferently.
"You don’t have a say in this. The duel is already set," she replied coldly. Though her voice was steady, she was clearly suppressing her anger.

She may have met with the Prince of the Kyrrith Kingdom about a potential marriage proposal that would benefit the Sword Gate of their sect. Inter-kingdom marriages like this happen all the time, and this time, it was her turn to enjoy the privilege.
But upon seeing her jewel had been tainted, she became furious. She resolved to ensure that Kent regretted his actions.
However, despite her sharp perception, she failed to realize that she had just challenged an arrogant dragon who thrived on chaos.

"If you’re going to measure my worth, why not make it 100 Sword Grandmasters instead? I mean, 50 Masters and Grandmasters sound like you’re making things too easy for me," Kent said with a smug smile.
His words, of course, took everyone by surprise. Even Gate Master Mara couldn’t maintain her composure.

"I don’t mean to disrespect, but I don’t think things will look good for your Sword Gate when the news spreads that a random 18-year-old stormed the sect, challenged 50 swordsmen, and won like it was nothing.

At least if the news is going to travel, it should sound more like this: a handsome young man, the kind every mother would want near her daughters, stormed into the Sword Gate of the Divine Palace Sect and challenged 100 Grandmaster swordsmen, winning every match as if it were nothing."
Kent moved closer to the Sword Gate Master and said something that made her raise an eyebrow.
"I mean, would the disciples be able to fight someone who possesses sword intent, sword qi, and a Sword Body?"
As he said that, Kent unleashed all three, causing the Gate Master to take a few steps back. She glanced toward the Saintess, who now had a smug expression.
At that moment, the Gate Master realized she had made a mistake. However, since she had issued the challenge, she could only try to find a way to take it back.
Yet her words faltered, unable to escape her lips, as Kent spoke again.
"My name is Kent. Kent Madson. I am the one and only disciple of the Sword Saintess Selene. Two days from now, I will challenge 100 Grandmaster Swordsmen to a duel.
If you have the guts—or the courage—to take up the challenge, then meet me wherever the Trial of the Sword is held.
If I lose, I will accept being crippled and expelled.

However, if you win, you will receive this Heaven-Grade Sword Skill, these one million Spirit Stones, and a signed contract from the Sword Saintess herself stating that whoever defeats me will become her disciple.
I will leave all the rewards with the Gate Master to ensure there’s no cheating. See you losers later!"
The disciples who heard his challenge began spreading the word, exaggerating it further with each retelling.
Naturally, in two days, thousands would gather, eager to challenge the arrogant Kent, who may have just angered the entire sect with his brazen words.
With that, the Sword Saintess, along with her three sisters, left the gate and headed toward her residence. She wanted to drop Kent off before taking Unity and Elsa to where they could register.
The Gate Master, who had received the three items, stood there for a few minutes before leaving with her five disciples.

Just now, she had sensed something when Kent unleashed his aura. It was the kind that only those who have fought and killed for thousands of years could wield, and thus, she knew that in two days, she would witness something that would change her worldview.
Of course, she had no intention of hoping for his victory. However, even with that thought, she could tell she had no way of preventing it. She could only ensure he never succeeded.
If only she knew that in two days, Kent would make another announcement that would shatter the will and passion of many swordsmen.
At that moment, she would realize one thing...
In all the 1,003 years she had lived and the hundreds of battles she had fought, for the first time in her life, she would understand the sentence many immortals had passed down to the ancestors:
"There are the Talented, the Geniuses, and the Prodigies. However, beyond these three, there exist those known as Monsters."
A few hours after Kent made his declaration, news began to spread throughout the Sword Gate and even reached the other gates.
Everyone who heard the news had the same reaction—they clenched their fists in anger. The audacity of the challenge was simply too much.
However, when they learned about the stakes of the challenge, everyone smiled. Just like that, the sword geniuses within the Sword Gate started registering their names.
In two days, they would teach that arrogant bastard, who dared challenge them all, a lesson. After all, he was the disciple of everyone’s idol... the Sword Saintess.

chapters.title: Chapter 173: I May Have Gone Overboard
paragraphs: "Kent, how were you able to stay composed and even joke with that woman? I mean, I heard from most of the disciples in the Mage Gate that, aside from the Sect Master, she is the strongest in this Sect,"
Lilian asked as they moved toward Saintess Selene’s residence. She had a mini-mansion to herself, so Kent would be staying there as expected, considering he was her disciple.
"In my hometown, we call it ’rizz.’ I wasn’t about to look scared and cower like a little bird in front of a beauty like that," Kent said, smiling and already forming ideas.

"I think you should measure yourself to your size for now. Master wouldn’t hesitate to cut off your head if you try anything funny. Even kings wouldn’t dare," Saintess Selene said, looking at Kent with pity in her eyes.
"But Sister Selene, you never told us you have a master," Unity stated, or rather asked.
"She is no longer my master. She stopped being my master after I became a Sword Saintess. But before that, she was the one who taught me everything I know about swords," Selene answered with a smile.
Kent looked at her expression and shook his head.
"You never said anything about her before. Were you perhaps scared she would do something like this?" Kent asked.
While inside the tower, he had told her about his plan to challenge a hundred people when he entered the sect. Of course, she objected, but after a few rounds and a little convincing, she saw reason.
Kent then went ahead and laid out the perfect plan.

However, everything came crashing down in the most spectacular way when the Gate Master intervened. So, while he wasn’t ready to make his move, he also wasn’t about to lose his composure in such a state.
He impulsively went ahead with his plan and went ahead of schedule. What he never expected was the relationship between his master and the Gate Master.
"I guess I was afraid something like this would happen, considering Master is someone who tends to know things that are hidden," Saintess Selene replied, shaking her head.
"So you think she knew about us?" Kent asked.

"Definitely. If not, she wouldn’t have punished you that harshly. It seems she was still hoping I would marry into a wealthy family so I could better support the Sword Gate," Saintess Selene said with a smile.
"Don’t worry, I will ensure she understands that I’m the best person for you. If she doesn’t listen to reason, I’ll just find a way to make her hear reason," Kent said, smiling confidently.
"You may have made her mad, you know."

"I might have gone overboard. However, I needed that, considering I have things I need to accomplish soon. But don’t worry—I have over 30 days to prepare, so there’s nothing to worry about her," Kent replied.
The four ladies smiled, knowing he was talking about the tower.
Inside the tower, time flows differently compared to the outside. This means he will have more than enough time inside to become a Sword Grandmaster.
"This means I won’t be able to escort you ladies around the sect."
"Don’t worry, we will be fine. Sister Selene is with us, so we will be fine. Just train hard, considering if you lose, you will lose face and get crippled," Unity giggled as she said that.
Kent had already told them his plan and assured them he would win. The question now, however, was how he was going to do it.

"But you have to be careful, though. The five disciples behind the gate master will, without a doubt, join the challenge. They are her personal disciples, and as she did with me, she is drilling the path of the sword into them.

They may not have a sword body yet, but they have sword intent and sword qi and have mastered it to the 4th level and above. Also, they have more experience in battle than you, so you will have to be careful.
But aside from them, some hidden dragons within the sect would love to become famous by defeating the disciple of the Sword Saintess.
I won’t say much, considering no matter what, you will be facing them, but just be careful and prepare."
As soon as she finished saying that, they appeared in front of her residence, which was in perfect shape, just as she had left it a few months ago.
Kent scanned the area and could tell there were formations inside—some for defense, some to prevent spying, and others to cancel all forms of sound.
Kent smiled, knowing the noise-canceling formation would come in handy in the coming days, provided they didn’t enter the tower to do it there.
"This is my training ground. There is a formation around it that prevents one from dying, even if their head is chopped off."
Saintess Selene said, leading Kent and the rest of her sisters through the garden training ground. It looked fancy for a training ground.
After passing through, they made their way across the landscape and finally entered the house. It was clean and well-decorated.
Kent quickly scanned it and noticed a formation that helped maintain the neatness of the house at all times.
"I personally designed it, if that’s what you’re wondering," Saintess Selene said, looking smug. Kent moved closer and grabbed her ass, making Elsa, Lilian, and Unity roll their eyes.

However, after spending two weeks being intimate with her man, the Innocent Saintess had long become the Lustful Saintess.
"So, where would we be staying?" Kent asked, massaging Selene’s ass.
Saintess Selene led him to a fancy room housing a bed large enough for five people. Kent immediately jumped onto the bed, dragging the saintess with him.
A few seconds later, the sound of kissing filled the room, forcing the ladies standing and watching to roll their eyes before leaving to check the other rooms in the house.
Soon, moaning filled the house, signaling that Kent and his master were having a moment before he entered the tower to begin his training.
Her moaning continued for a few hours until it finally subsided. They freshened up and went to meet the three ladies who were patiently waiting for them.
"Unity, you should do your best and pass the exams. Afterward, I will reward you," Kent said to Unity before turning to Elsa.

Lilian asked as they moved toward Saintess Selene’s residence.

chapters.title: Chapter 174: Anticipation...
paragraphs: "Max, have you heard..." a young man asked his friend, who was hacking away at a training dummy with a wooden sword.
"Heard what?" The one referred to as Max asked, momentarily pausing his sword practice and turning to face his friend.

"Some bastard by the name of Kent, who happens to be the disciple of the Sword Saintess, challenged 100 Grandmaster Swordsmen. The battle will happen in two days in the arena meant for the Trial of the Sword," the young man said, making Max furrow his brow.
"Well, he is bold, but I’m afraid he’ll just be disgracing himself." Saying that, Max resumed his training.
He was one of the finest Grandmaster Swordsmen in the sect, so this challenge was right up his alley. Of course, while he appeared composed, he was cursing Kent in his heart.
Why?
He was one of the many who had aspired to become the disciple of the Sword Saintess. Hearing that she now had a disciple was a harsh blow to him.
Of course, he could join the challenge, but it would be of no use considering she had already chosen her disciple, and there was no changing that.
Well... that was until his friend Dominic uttered the next few words. His mind changed immediately.
"Whoever manages to defeat him will get a Heaven-grade sword skill, 100 million spirit stones, and a chance to become the disciple of the Sword Saintess..."
Immediately after Max heard that, he dropped the wooden sword and sped toward the registration centre, hoping he wasn’t too late.
Of course, he would have a chance, considering he was ranked within the top 20 on the Grandmaster Swordsmen chart.
He would still have a chance even if over a hundred people had already registered.
The Gate Master would make sure of that.

Kent’s disrespect was something she wouldn’t take lying down. In fact, she had already warned her five disciples to do whatever it took to win, considering she wasn’t about to let a youngster have his way with her disciple just like that.
Though the aura Kent unleashed was powerful, she trusted in her disciples and knew Kent wouldn’t be able to have a shot at winning this challenge.
After Max left, Dominic followed.
However, it wasn’t just Max who had heard about Kent’s challenge; hundreds and thousands of others had also heard of it and were currently making their way to register.

Meanwhile, Saintess Selene, along with Elsa and Unity, made their way to the Archer Gate. Lilian had already returned to the Mage Gate, where she planned to immediately inform her friends about what was happening in the Sword Gate.
Unity, who held the Token of Privilege, was allowed to take the exams for the inner disciples, which consisted merely of some hunting trials.
They took her to a hunting field where she was tasked with hunting Tier 4 Spirit Beasts. It took her less than 30 minutes to hunt ten beasts, passing the trial.

The trial was timed at 60 minutes, but she managed it in under 30. The moment she was done with that, she was taken to her room and given uniforms and other essentials she would need while inside the sect.
Of course, with the Sword Saintess present, she received the best of the items. She introduced Unity as her sworn sister, so things went smoothly for her.
When everything was set, she bid Unity goodbye and left with Elsa.
At first, Elsa had wanted to join the Sword Gate, considering she also wielded a sword. However, she reconsidered that idea and chose to join the Soul Gate instead.
In the Divine Palace Sect, there are seven gates, each specializing in a specific field: Sword Gate, Archer Gate, Soul Gate, Alchemy Gate, Mage Gate, Body Gate, and Spear Gate.
Of course, the Soul and Alchemy Gates are closely related, as most soul cultivators are also alchemists.

However, just as there are alchemy enthusiasts, there are also soul cultivators who are not alchemists. This was the path Elsa wanted to pursue, and with her strong connection to the soul, the Soul Gate was a perfect fit for her.
As expected, when she registered as a challenger, she won against her opponent, who was also a Root Sage.

In fact, Elsa won with just a single soul attack, which immediately caught the attention of the Soul Gate Master. He promptly asked her if she wanted to become a true disciple and even offered to take her as his personal disciple.
Of course, Elsa accepted both offers, as Vexthra had advised her not to reveal her true identity. If she were to reject him and later display extraordinary abilities, he would become suspicious.
However, by employing the age-old tactic of hiding in plain sight and using his resources to steadily develop, she ensured he would not suspect anything.
She even played her part well by showcasing her inexperienced nature during the battle despite winning easily. This was all part of Vexthra’s plan.
Now that she had managed to not only become a Core Disciple but also the disciple of the Gate Master, Elsa had practically ascended to a position of power within the Soul Gate.
The Gate Master immediately sent her into the Soul Pagoda, one of the most powerful treasures of the Soul Gate, where she was tasked with comprehending at least two Soul Skills before coming out.
Once she was settled in, Saintess Selene departed. She went to the Mage Gate to see Lilian and ensure that she was recognized as her sworn sister. This was to guarantee that she wouldn’t be bullied.
Among all the gates, the Mage Gate was where beauties and bullies congregated. It was also the largest of them all, and it was where most of the powerful disciples could be found.
There were hidden dragons among them.

So, in order to avoid making her a target of bullies, she ensured everyone knew she was Lilian’s sister. This, of course, elevated Lilian’s status, making her one of the most popular mages in the Mage Gate.
After completing her task, Selene left and headed to the Spear Gate to see her best friend, who had been her sister since they were young.
But while all this was happening, somewhere in the Kyrrith Kingdom, the wicked Poison Witch was in the final phase of her experiment.
She was creating a pill recipe that would undoubtedly become one of the most powerful poison pills on the continent.
It was a Tier 7 pill, and she had completed 98% of the experiment. She was nearing the final stage.
However, while she was making progress, her disciple, Annabelle, couldn’t seem to focus. She was giddy with anticipation at the thought of slapping Kent in the face for disrespecting her.

She was arrogant, and as someone who had been humiliated and whose shame had already spread, she knew without a shadow of a doubt that if she didn’t slap Kent, she wouldn’t be able to sleep peacefully.
Annabelle had always gotten her way, thanks to her master’s influence. However, after meeting Kent, she began to realize that, without her master, she was a nobody.
This realization made her feel weak, and she hated it. She wanted to feel strong again, and the only way to achieve that was to take revenge on the one who had disrespected her.
If only she knew what she had gotten herself into... well.

chapters.title: Chapter 175: You Did What...?
paragraphs: When Saintess Selene arrived at the Spear Gate, specifically at the residence of Neomi, her sister, she had already devised the best way to handle her time there in order not to reveal her relationship with Kent.
She needed some time to let her sister know that she was now a woman in love and had fallen for her disciple. It was an absurd thing to admit, but it was also the undeniable truth.
"I will take it slowly," she resolved.
After making up her mind, she entered the residence without any resistance. Just like her own place, Neomi’s residence was also protected by formations.
"Big sister, I’m back," Saintess Selene said, stepping inside the house.
The moment she entered, she found herself face-to-face with a beautiful lady about the same age as her but far more voluptuous in all the right places.

Selene hugged her sister tightly for a few seconds, behaving like a puppy that had missed its master. At that moment, that was exactly what Saintess Selene was. But it was normal, considering she could only show this side of herself around her sister—until she met Kent.
"I missed you, big sister," Saintess Selene said, smiling.
Neomi arched an eyebrow upon seeing her sister’s cute and genuine smile. It was surprising, considering Selene wasn’t the smiling type just a few months ago.
"Let’s forget the fact that a 60-plus-year-old woman like yourself will never stop behaving like a puppy and focus on why you’re smiling. It seems you’re happy," Neomi said, looking at her strangely.
"Did something good happen?" she asked.
Aside from the time Selene became a Saintess, nothing good had ever happened to her. It was as if she had been born with bad luck.
For her to be smiling like that, Neomi knew her better than anyone else and suspected that something good might indeed have occurred.
"Big sister, why do you assume I’m only happy because something good happened? Can’t I just be happy because I want to?" Selene pouted, which turned out to be a mistake.
She had never pouted before.

In the past, she despised people who pouted. Neomi couldn’t help but finally accept that her sister had indeed become a different person. Forget about something good happening—she may have actually experienced something extraordinary.
Neomi knew her well, and because of that, she was sure something wasn’t right.
When they ran away from the orphanage, Neomi was 15, while Selene was 13. She had taken care of her for years until Selene came of age and started doing her own things.
But even behind the scenes, Neomi continued to protect her so she could tell when something was wrong. And at this moment, she knew something was definitely off with her sister.
"Spill it..." Neomi demanded with a frown.
Selene looked at her frowning expression and chuckled.
"You are always so serious about things, big sister. This is why I don’t like coming here," Selene pouted again, but this time, she chose to reveal her big secret.
"I found a disciple... finally,"
She said with a smile that made Neomi finally understand why she was happy. ’So she has found someone good with the sword like her... I wonder who it is,’ she thought inwardly.
"Who is it? Is she better than you?" Neomi asked.
Selene looked at her and shook her head. It seemed the news hadn’t reached her yet about her disciple offending everyone in the Sword Gate on his first day.
"My disciple is not a she, sister. It’s a he, and his name is Kent Madson."
Neomi raised both eyebrows upon hearing her reply. Yet again, she was taken aback.
Why...?

Because she knew Selene, and in all the years she had known her, Selene would never choose a male disciple. They both despised men, a sentiment rooted in a horrifying incident they had witnessed years ago in the orphanage.
Even after exacting revenge, they never let go of that hatred. So, never in her wildest dreams did Neomi expect her sister to take in a male disciple.
"Are you being serious?" she asked, looking skeptical. She didn’t know if Selene was just messing with her or if she was serious.
After all, Selene had changed over the past few weeks that she had been away from the sect...
The Selene in front of her and the one she knew seemed different.
If this had been like a year of separation, she would have pulled her weapon and lunged at her with the excuse that Selene had been possessed or something.
Something was indeed very wrong with her, and while she didn’t know yet, she would soon find out. After tasting the forbidden fruit, her disciple had to offer, her hidden tigress had awakened.
Right now, she could have sex with Kent right in front of his other women without any shyness. Of course, she wasn’t about to say all this... yet.
"I am serious, Big Sister," Selene answered. "My disciple is a male named Kent."

"I see. Good for you, I guess. The fact that you picked him is enough to convince me he is capable," Neomi replied, accepting her disciple like a good sister. She wasn’t about to reprimand her over her lifelong decision.
’Oh he is capable alright...’ Selene smiled thinking of that... Of course, she wasn’t about to say it out loud.
"Can you tell me more about this Kent?"
Of course, the fact that she wouldn’t reprimand her didn’t mean she was about to stand by and watch her make such a decision without thinking it through.
She wouldn’t stop her from choosing her disciple, but she would use her outside perspective to examine whether Kent was bad news for her sister.
If only this had been before she climbed into his bed... But who cares?
"Kent is a hardworking swordsman. Even at just 18 years old, he has already mastered Sword Qi, Sword Aura, and awakened the Sword Body..."
"Wait, what?" Neomi said, her expression turning to shock. "Are you sure? Does he really have all three?" she asked.

"Yes, Big Sister," Selene answered smugly. "Why would I take him as my disciple if he wasn’t that talented? I have to tell you, Big Sister, Kent is no ordinary talent. Even I pale in comparison to him."
Neomi didn’t respond immediately, but inwardly, she was stunned. ’Less than 20 years old, yet already possessing the three key aspects of a swordsman? What kind of monster has she picked up?’
Suddenly, her curiosity was sparked. She wanted to know more about this mysterious Kent.
"Tell me more about this Kent," she said, a small smile playing on her lips.
Selene also smiled, sensing her sister’s growing interest. "Well, Kent is caring, hardworking, and handsome," Saintess Selene said with a cute smile that made Neomi raise an eyebrow.
"Why are you looking at me like that?" Selene asked, noticing Neomi’s strange expression.
"You look... different. At first, I couldn’t place it, but when you started talking about your disciple, I finally realized where the change is coming from."
Selene’s heart skipped a beat. She wasn’t prepared for such a perceptive deduction. Neomi noticed her sudden unease, her sharp instincts sensing something was amiss.
"You didn’t..." Neomi said, shaking her head in disbelief.
Selene met her gaze and smiled. "It was better than we imagined... And yes, I slept with my disciple, Big Sister," she admitted with a proud smile.
"You did what...?" Neomi exclaimed.

"You are always so serious about things, big sister.
This is why I don’t like coming here," Selene pouted again, but this time, she chose to reveal her big secret.
"I found a disciple... finally,"
She said with a smile that made Neomi finally understand why she was happy. ’So she has found someone good with the sword like her...
I wonder who it is,’ she thought inwardly.
"Who is it?
Is she better than you?" Neomi asked.
Selene looked at her and shook her head.
It seemed the news hadn’t reached her yet about her disciple offending everyone in the Sword Gate on his first day.
"My disciple is not a she, sister.
It’s a he, and his name is Kent Madson."
Neomi raised both eyebrows upon hearing her reply.
Yet again, she was taken aback.
Why...?
Because she knew Selene, and in all the years she had known her, Selene would never choose a male disciple.
They both despised men, a sentiment rooted in a horrifying incident they had witnessed years ago in the orphanage.
Even after exacting revenge, they never let go of that hatred.
So, never in her wildest dreams did Neomi expect her sister to take in a male disciple.
"Are you being serious?" she asked, looking skeptical.
She didn’t know if Selene was just messing with her or if she was serious.
After all, Selene had changed over the past few weeks that she had been away from the sect...
The Selene in front of her and the one she knew seemed different.
If this had been like a year of separation, she would have pulled her weapon and lunged at her with the excuse that Selene had been possessed or something.
Something was indeed very wrong with her, and while she didn’t know yet, she would soon find out.
After tasting the forbidden fruit, her disciple had to offer, her hidden tigress had awakened.
Right now, she could have sex with Kent right in front of his other women without any shyness.
Of course, she wasn’t about to say all this... yet.
"I am serious, Big Sister," Selene answered.
"My disciple is a male named Kent."
"I see.
Good for you, I guess.
The fact that you picked him is enough to convince me he is capable," Neomi replied, accepting her disciple like a good sister.
She wasn’t about to reprimand her over her lifelong decision.
’Oh he is capable alright...’ Selene smiled thinking of that...
Of course, she wasn’t about to say it out loud.
"Can you tell me more about this Kent?"
Of course, the fact that she wouldn’t reprimand her didn’t mean she was about to stand by and watch her make such a decision without thinking it through.
She wouldn’t stop her from choosing her disciple, but she would use her outside perspective to examine whether Kent was bad news for her sister.
If only this had been before she climbed into his bed...
But who cares?
"Kent is a hardworking swordsman.
Even at just 18 years old, he has already mastered Sword Qi, Sword Aura, and awakened the Sword Body..."
"Wait, what?" Neomi said, her expression turning to shock.
"Are you sure?
Does he really have all three?" she asked.
"Yes, Big Sister," Selene answered smugly.
"Why would I take him as my disciple if he wasn’t that talented?
I have to tell you, Big Sister, Kent is no ordinary talent.
Even I pale in comparison to him."
Neomi didn’t respond immediately, but inwardly, she was stunned. ’Less than 20 years old, yet already possessing the three key aspects of a swordsman?
What kind of monster has she picked up?’
Suddenly, her curiosity was sparked.
She wanted to know more about this mysterious Kent.
"Tell me more about this Kent," she said, a small smile playing on her lips.
Selene also smiled, sensing her sister’s growing interest.
"Well, Kent is caring, hardworking, and handsome," Saintess Selene said with a cute smile that made Neomi raise an eyebrow.
"Why are you looking at me like that?" Selene asked, noticing Neomi’s strange expression.
"You look... different.
At first, I couldn’t place it, but when you started talking about your disciple, I finally realized where the change is coming from."
Selene’s heart skipped a beat.
She wasn’t prepared for such a perceptive deduction.
Neomi noticed her sudden unease, her sharp instincts sensing something was amiss.
"You didn’t..." Neomi said, shaking her head in disbelief.
Selene met her gaze and smiled.
"It was better than we imagined...
And yes, I slept with my disciple, Big Sister," she admitted with a proud smile.
"You did what...?" Neomi exclaimed.

chapters.title: Chapter 176: I Want You to Become His Woman Too...
paragraphs: Neomi could only stare at her sister, a shocked expression painted on her face. It was as if she had heard something that shouldn’t be said.
Her sister, the same Saintess Selene she knew, had just confessed that she had become a woman—and it was with her very own disciple. That was just too much for her to comprehend.
However, looking at the smile on Selene’s face, Neomi could tell she was happy, unlike the traumatized expression she had seen years ago when they witnessed the incident at the orphanage.
This puzzled her, considering she herself hadn’t gotten over it. It was a traumatic experience for both of them.
But looking at her sister now, she could tell that Selene had moved on and was now genuinely happy.
"Why did you do it?" she asked.
"Because I love him, and I wanted to be happy. So I gave myself to him, and I am very happy now," Selene said, her face radiating joy.

"Why him? You had thousands of powerhouses chasing after you every single day. Scratch that—you had princes and heirs asking for your hand in marriage every single day. So why... why would you give your purity to a mere disciple?
I don’t understand," Neomi said, her expression puzzled.
"Well, first of all, his penis is big and beautiful—"
"Selene!" Neomi shouted, her cheeks flushing as Selene giggled mischievously.
"What? You wanted to understand why I gave my purity to him, so I’m explaining," Selene replied with a smug smile.
"You’ve changed, and I don’t think I like the new you," Neomi said, shaking her head in disbelief.

"That’s because you haven’t experienced what I have. That’s why you’re saying this. But just so you know, what we saw was different from what I experienced. It was far better and sweeter than we ever imagined."
Selene took Neomi’s hand gently, determination gleaming in her eyes. No matter what, she had made up her mind—she must bring her sister into the fold.
Why?

Because she was now sister to a goddess. Who wouldn’t want that? In fact, she even planned to convince the Gate Master to join, but first, she had to sway her stubborn sister, who was acting just like Selene had in the past.
If only Kent could see how shameless the once-innocent Saintess had become, he would probably smile and say, "I am the man."
Indeed, through his efforts, the timid and traumatized Saintess had blossomed into the woman she was now.
In fact, she would forever remember her first time—not just as a milestone but as the moment she discovered there was something beyond swords that she would cherish forever.

"You don’t have to look at me like that, sister. I am still your little sister, the one you protected all these years. I haven’t changed. However, I am happy now, and because of the bond we share, I want you to be happy too."
Selene smiled, looking at Neomi, who was lost in thought.

"I had fun this past week, and it was all thanks to my man, who is also my disciple. I love him, and I know you will love him too. After all, he is someone who can make you feel things you never thought possible."
"What things?" she asked, making Selene smile.
"For starters, his penis, like I said, is gorgeous." She blushed, making Neomi blush as well, though she recovered faster than her sister.

"When I first made him my disciple, I thought he was only talented with the sword and handsome. But later, I found out he was much more interesting. Do you know his plan from the start was to pin me down in his bed?"
"And he told me without any fear in his eyes."
"I guess he is bold. The Selene I knew would cut down anyone who was that bold and shameless," Neomi said, smiling a little.
"He is shameless, alright, but he is also handsome and a good person. When I first saw him naked, I knew then and there that I was doomed. Of course, I planned on running away, but I couldn’t."
"Why?" Neomi was thinking the same thing. She would have run away if she were in her sister’s place.
"Because I wanted to taste it. I wanted to feel it, so I allowed myself to fulfill that desire, and I was happy I made the choice."
Selene led Neomi to a certain part of the house that had an orange plant and sat down on a small bench.
"Why are you telling me all this?" Neomi asked. Of course, she knew the reason behind her sister’s words, but she wanted to hear it from her.
"I want you to become his woman too," Selene said.
"You can’t be serious." Neomi just smiled. She wasn’t angry at her silly sister’s serious words.

"I am serious, sister. Kent is the man for you. I know you want to become a woman but are afraid you can’t go through with it, so why don’t you first get to know him? If you like him, you can go through with it.
But be prepared. After your first time with him, I’m sure you’ll have a blast," she giggled and placed her head on Neomi’s shoulder, hugging her arm. He was very happy at the moment...
However, Neomi was having a hard time accepting how shameless her sister had become. But she could tell that Selene was happy—very happy, in fact.
’Does that disciple of hers really have what it takes to make her this happy? Could I also become this happy?’ she wondered but quickly held herself back from deep diving into such thoughts.

She knew, however, that things wouldn’t be that easy. She must first meet Kent and, if necessary, kidnap and interrogate him. Only after confirming that he wasn’t a threat to her sister would she be able to calm down.
"Of course, if you want, you can stay in my house and spy on us while we do it. All your questions will be answered," Selene giggled again as she spoke.
Neomi smacked the back of her head, shocked by such a shameless suggestion—especially since it was exactly what she had been secretly considering.
"By the way, where is Ingrid? Your beloved disciple never left your side whenever I come to visit," Selene asked.
Neomi sighed, knowing what she knew.

"Ingrid has locked herself in her room, refusing to come out." Neomi smiled slightly. "She seems to have noticed something similar to ours, but in her case, it wasn’t a traumatizing experience. This, of course, made her become more excited."
Selene turned and gave her sister a look. "More excited? Is that the best you can do?"
"Well, she doesn’t know I know, but she seems to have reached the stage where you are now."
"So, she wants to experience sex. Good for her, unlike you, who seems to still be in your old ways," Selene smiled before standing up.
"She needs to go out, and since her auntie is back, I will take her out. After all, my disciple will be taking the Trial of the Sword in 38 hours’ time. What better way to go out?"
Selene left and headed to Ingrid’s room. If only she knew her man was the cause of her torture, she would already make her understand she has nothing to worry about...
The Chaos Dragon has finally arrived in the sect; things are, of course, bound to change quickly...

chapters.title: Chapter 177: Grandmaster Swordsman, Hidden Talent
paragraphs: It had already been 46 days since Kent entered the tower to prepare for the impromptu challenge he had thrown out in order not to lose face.

On the outside, however, only 46 hours had passed, meaning Kent had only 2 hours before the trial began. In fact, the arena was already filled with people seated and eager to witness yet another downfall of an unfortunate sword genius.
That is what they all are expecting...
Everyone knew that whenever the Trial of the Sword was open, the one being challenged never managed to make it through unscathed.
For this particular trial, people were furious and ready to boo and hurl insults at Kent for raising the stakes—making it 100 Grandmaster challenges instead of just 50 Masters and Grandmasters.
News of his challenge had already reached the ears of everyone in the Divine Palace Sect. Both Outer, Inner, and Core disciples were aware of Kent’s audacious display.
Everyone wanted to see him crash and burn.
Meanwhile, as the crowd anticipated his inevitable failure, Kent was hard at work inside the Sword Tower.
For the past 40 days, he had been tempering his body with the herbs he had acquired at the Green Gate Bazaar.
His plan was to follow Vexthra’s method and become a body cultivator, which would significantly enhance his Sword Body, according to her.

Right now, Kent is only at the Fledgling stage of Sword Body. However, if he manages to become a body cultivator, his Sword Body and real body will transform into a Copper Body, which, according to the goddess, will elevate his stamina to a new level.
Kent spent 40 days solely tempering his body. At first, there was no progress at all. His body absorbed every last herb, but nothing seemed to happen.

Thirty days later, his last herb was used up, so Kent had to resort to using the poisonous herbs he had. Of course, he couldn’t use them outright. Before doing so, he first purchased some items from the tower store.
Fortunately, he had enough Tower Points.
He then resumed his tempering, this time using the poisonous herbs. The process was excruciating, but it proved worthwhile, as he managed to become a body cultivator on the 38th day.
In fact, when he awakened his body, he felt a surge of powerful energy fill him, enhancing not only his stamina but also his physical and mental strength.
It was a great boon that made him grow even stronger than the strongest Root Grandmaster or even a Root Saint.

As he had expected, the Body Tower opened, but he didn’t waste time exploring it. Instead, he immediately focused on mastering the remaining sword techniques. He had exactly 48 days, which was equivalent to 2 days in the outside world.
After spending 38 days becoming a body cultivator, Kent dedicated the remaining time to grinding hard on the remaining sword moves.
These techniques were some of the most complex, but thanks to the boons provided by the Sword Tower, the process wasn’t overly time-consuming.
Additionally, with the upgrades to both his stamina and mental strength, he became much more resilient on both fronts—mental and physical.
He then dived into the 10,002 swordplay mastery...his main objective after becoming a body cultivator...
He didn’t allow himself even a second of rest as he relentlessly swung his sword, drilling the techniques into his very bones.
Although he didn’t fully understand why he needed to learn and master all 10,002 swordplay techniques and styles from the beginning, as time passed, he began to realize the deeper purpose.
Not only was it giving him an unparalleled understanding of the sword, but it was also boosting all three of his core aspects.
It felt as if his Sword Body was being sharpened. His body, when wielding the sword, seemed to have become more refined and perfectly attuned with the sword.
He could see how sharp his sword intent and aura had also started to become. When he finally managed to grasp the 10,000 Sword Moves, he felt it.𝙛𝒓𝓮𝙚𝔀𝒆𝒃𝓷𝒐𝓿𝙚𝓵.𝙘𝒐𝒎
He could tell that the moment he finished mastering the last two moves, which would complete the set, something significant would happen, and he couldn’t afford to waste time.
In fact, Gaia and Akira used a strand of their consciousness to appear in the Sword Tower just to witness his awakening as a Grandmaster Swordsman.
On the 46th day, Kent mastered the final sword move, and everything turned chaotic.
A powerful gust of energy burst out of Kent’s body at once.
This energy wasn’t ordinary; it was so chaotic that if an expert were to witness it, they would immediately recognize it as one of the strongest energies in the cosmos—Chaos Energy.
The entire place descended into chaos, but that lasted only a few minutes until Kent’s sword qi stepped in and literally turned the air sharp.

It made everything so sharp that when Gaia moved a training doll on the same level as a Peak Sword Grandmaster into the air, it was sliced into countless pieces in ways no human or beast could withstand.

Then his Sword Intent entered, and everything spiralled out of control. In fact, forget a Sword Grandmaster— even a Sword Saint wouldn’t walk away unscathed unless they had a sword body and a deep understanding of sword qi.
Gaia looked at Akira, and the two giggled when Kent, without even realizing it, reduced a battle doll to shreds using just his sword qi and intent.
"The Genesis Sword Path..." they muttered simultaneously, watching the sharpened air around Kent grow even sharper.
A few hours into the breakthrough, Kent’s body began emitting flickers of lightning. Soon, however, lightning started dancing all over his body.
It extended to his sword, and before long, his body and the lightning became one. It was a mesmerizing sight to watch golden lightning dance around him.

Kent, seated in a lotus posture, remained in that state for a day and a half, holding his sword. When he finally opened his eyes, he swiftly sheathed his sword, and in an instant, both the sharpened air and the lightning vanished.
"Congratulations on your breakthrough, Master," Gaia said, appearing immediately in front of him. Akira wasn’t far behind.
"Thanks, Gaia, but it seems I now have a much more difficult path to walk," Kent said, his gaze fixed on the massive [Sword of Enlightenment].

He could tell he had received yet another task, but he wasn’t ready to tackle it just yet. The most important aspect was understanding the path he had to walk, and so far, he had managed to grasp a small part of it.
He looked at the sword sheathed into the sword sheath and smiled.
"So this was why you wanted me to get a sword sheath, huh? It was to contain the sword qi and intent I would release through my sword," Kent said with a smug smile.

"Yes, Master. The Genesis Path is the most difficult sword path, but it also has no equal. In your current state, if you don’t plan on killing your opponent, never draw your sword," Gaia said with a proud smile.

"On the bright side, you can always be arrogant and say things like, ’The moment I draw my sword is the moment you die,’ or ’You’re not worth me drawing my sword,’" Akira chimed in like a spoiled child.
"When you put it that way, I would indeed look cooler. Thanks, ladies. Now, care to tell me what’s happening outside?"
"Everybody is gathered to watch your downfall, Master," Gaia said.
The three of them looked at each other, and like best friends from a distant past, they burst into laughter, holding their stomachs.

"Thanks, Gaia, but it seems I now have a much more difficult path to walk," Kent said, his gaze fixed on the massive [Sword of Enlightenment].
He could tell he had received yet another task, but he wasn’t ready to tackle it just yet.
The most important aspect was understanding the path he had to walk, and so far, he had managed to grasp a small part of it.
He looked at the sword sheathed into the sword sheath and smiled.
"So this was why you wanted me to get a sword sheath, huh?
It was to contain the sword qi and intent I would release through my sword," Kent said with a smug smile.
"Yes, Master.
The Genesis Path is the most difficult sword path, but it also has no equal.
In your current state, if you don’t plan on killing your opponent, never draw your sword," Gaia said with a proud smile.

"On the bright side, you can always be arrogant and say things like, ’The moment I draw my sword is the moment you die,’ or ’You’re not worth me drawing my sword,’" Akira chimed in like a spoiled child.
"When you put it that way, I would indeed look cooler.
Thanks, ladies.
Now, care to tell me what’s happening outside?"
"Everybody is gathered to watch your downfall, Master," Gaia said.
The three of them looked at each other, and like best friends from a distant past, they burst into laughter, holding their stomachs.

chapters.title: Chapter 178: Trial of the Sword
paragraphs: All over the Sword Gate in the Divine Palace Sect, thousands of disciples gathered in a vast arena. It was the Arena of the Trial of the Sword.
Ever since its construction, it had only been used three times, with the last instance occurring 12 years ago when a Core disciple molested a fellow female disciple.
Back then, the Sword Gate Master wanted to sever his head from his body, but she was cautioned against it. Instead, she punished him through the challenge of the Sword Trial.

He lasted only seven matches before his head was cut off. However, due to the special formation in the arena that prevented death, when he reappeared outside, she administered the same punishment as she had to the two before him.
His cultivation was crippled, and he was expelled.
The Gate Master, a Level 8 Root Transcendent, is the second strongest in the Sect and highly skilled with the sword. Therefore, for her to punish Kent was a matter to be taken seriously.
However, instead of viewing it as a punishment, Kent saw it as an opportunity to gain fame and complete a valuable quest.
Now, everyone in the inner section of the sect, and even some Core disciples, had gathered to witness the downfall of the disciple of their idol—the Sword Saintess, Selene.

"I can’t believe I finally get to watch a Trial of the Sword... The last time it happened, I was just a Root Awakened who had only just discovered the sword," a disciple said, a blissful expression on his face, looking genuinely happy.
"Me too. But I learned from my sister, who was a Core disciple back then. She said the trial was one of the most eye-opening experiences a swordsman could witness," another disciple replied.
"How so?"
"She said that if you want to know where you’re lacking, and you can’t challenge, then you have to watch. According to her, watching this trial taught her a valuable lesson..."
"And that was?"
"Never allow yourself to enter this trial as the challenger... lol."
"Fuck you, Martin. I thought you were about to say something profound." Some of the disciples nearby laughed, overhearing the conversation between the two.
"No need to get angry, Knull. We all know this is a chance to see who will officially become the disciple of the Sword Saintess," Martin smiled.
"So, you’re dismissing the challenger, huh? Have you forgotten the lesson we learned in Elder Hans’ class? Never underestimate your opponent, even if you are far stronger than them," Knull asked.

"I am not underestimating him; I just don’t want to think of him at all. Haven’t you checked? All 10 Sword Geniuses in the Inner Section are on the list. I don’t know about you, but I don’t see this mysterious Kent winning even a single match."
"Plus, all five disciples of the Gate Master are on the list. Are you telling me the disciple of the Sword Saintess is better than the disciples of the Gate Master?"
Knull nodded. "When you put it that way, it indeed doesn’t seem like he has a shot."
The two continued their conversation as did many others, and at every turn, no one believed Kent could win even a single match.
In the sect, some of the most powerful sword geniuses had awakened sword qi and sword intent at very young ages.

They had also completed some of the most dangerous missions in the academy. So, no matter what, a nobody who happened to be the disciple of their Sword Idol wouldn’t stand a chance of winning even a single match.
A few hours after they entered the arena, the Sword Saintess appeared with Ingrid, another genius in the sect.
Ingrid was the disciple of the Spear Saintess and one of the most powerful Core Disciples in the sect.
Many knew her to have a good relationship with the Sword Saintess, mainly because she was one of the three people permitted to enter her home.
Still, they never expected her to appear in the arena. Of course, her fans began shouting her name alongside their idol, the Sword Saintess.
A few minutes after the Sword Saintess appeared, the Gate Master arrived with her five disciples: Zayd, Lancen, Penn, Zhen, and Ava.
The crowd went wild when they appeared, cheering loudly for them.
The five disciples were like celebrities. In the sect, aside from the Saintess and the Core Disciples, these five were the most popular and famous.
They had been chosen as disciples immediately after joining the sect.
Strangely enough, they all joined on the same day, making it seem like a package deal delivered to the Tower Master, who had since been training and guiding them.

Rumour had it that after her first disciple became a Saintess, the Gate Master was determined to cultivate five more prodigies. Because of this, all five of her disciples, while undeniably arrogant, were also driven to become the best of the best.
As they entered, more famous faces in the sect were recognized among the crowd.
The Gate Master walked straight to the Sword Saintess. With eyes blazing with anger, an emotion only Selene could recognize, she asked:
"Where is that arrogant disciple of yours?" Her tone was cold.
’Keep being cold; sooner rather than later, you’ll be screaming in his bed,’ Saintess Selene thought about saying that, but she valued her life. Instead, she smiled and said something more agreeable.
"He will come, Gate Master. No need to be alarmed."
"Tsk, who is alarmed? I just hope he can maintain his arrogance when he’s getting crippled." After saying that, she moved to her section of the seats, not even giving Selene a chance to reply.
Selene wasn’t offended. She knew her uptight master... hell, she had even learned most of her uptightness from her, so she didn’t take it personally.

She continued talking to Ingrid, whom she had finally managed to bring outside after some much-needed convincing. She’d had to sacrifice the sex magazine Kent had given her before she managed to get her to come out.
A few minutes after the interaction with the Gate Master, Spear Saintess Neomi also arrived and sat beside Selene and her disciple, Ingrid.
Of course, she said hi to the Gate Master, who was surprisingly chummy with her—for the first time ever.
Selene immediately realized that perhaps she was trying to get her on her side now that she was spoken for. She just laughed inwardly. She knew all her plans would soon come crashing down...
When the time came, an elder stepped into the arena.
"Welcome, everyone, to the Fourth Trial of the Sword." The crowd quieted down.

"Today, Challenger Kent Madson, a Level 8 Root Grandmaster, has challenged 100 Grandmaster Swordsmen from the Inner Area of the Sword Gate to a duel. While it may sound arrogant, you should all know that Kent is the disciple of none other than our very own Sword Saintess.

"Now, if you are still not convinced, know this: the one who manages to defeat him will receive a Heaven-Grade Sword Skill, 100 million spirit stones, and the chance to become the disciple of the Sword Saintess...
"That is, assuming her disciple ends up crippled, of course."
"Now, while this is already known, death in this trial is not permanent, so to all challengers, don’t hold back.
Also, from the Gate Master, the one who manages to defeat Kent Madson will have a chance to enter the Sword Garden for two days."
Everyone went wild, regardless of whether they were spectators or challengers. The perks were just too enticing.
Nobody would want to miss out on that... In fact, if the first three perks weren’t there, just having a chance to enter the Sword Garden was enough to make them go all out.

Not even the Sword Saintess could boast of having a chance to enter the Sword Garden... the most sacred place in the sect. And now, it’s being offered for two days to whoever manages to take down Kent.
"Without further ado, let’s welcome our challenger, Kent Madson!"
Everyone quieted down and waited for Kent to appear. They finally wanted to see who the bastard looked like. However, even after ten minutes of waiting, nobody appeared.
Everyone, including the Gate Master, became enraged. This wasn’t something they had all expected... Kent is running away before the Trial...
Kent running was a bummer and a rather shameful act that could affect the Sword Saintess.
Well, that was what they all expected until a sneer entered everyone’s ears...
"What a bunch of uptight people... Don’t you all eat before trials like this?"
Kent appeared, holding an apple in his right hand and a sword inside a golden sheath in his left. Following him were two lolis, Gaia and Akira, who pleaded to come and cheer for him.

chapters.title: Chapter 179: Kent’s Speech
paragraphs: The moment Kent’s voice entered everyone’s ears, all eyes turned in his direction. There, they saw a handsome bastard munching on an apple and walking toward the arena casually.
In his hands was perhaps the most beautiful sword sheath they had ever seen. Though they were seething in anger, they couldn’t deny that Kent was indeed a feast for the eyes.𝒇𝙧𝙚𝓮𝙬𝙚𝓫𝒏𝓸𝓿𝓮𝒍.𝓬𝙤𝓶
In fact, every lady there, including the elders, raised an eyebrow when they saw the handsome Kent walking toward the stage.
Meanwhile, sitting beside Saintess Selene, Ingrid placed her hands in front of her mouth, her eyes widening when she saw Kent appear.
Saintess Selene, who had already expected this due to how she described her first encounter, remained quiet, connecting the dots and smiling.
Kent had already told his women about Alina and even shared how they met and how their first time happened.
So when she spoke to Ingrid and found out that she had seen the two of them in the auction house, she could only smile and wait for this moment.
"That is my disciple, Kent. Isn’t he handsome?" Saintess Selene said, looking at the shocked and flustered Ingrid.
Ingrid nodded absentmindedly.
But of course, even Saintess Neomi couldn’t deny it—Kent was indeed handsome.
However, now wasn’t the time to focus on that.
"Who are those two cute ladies behind him?" someone asked, making everyone start to wonder. Akira was rocking her usual tank top and short jeans with a nice set of cute little shoes.
Her black, small backpack was still on her back, and her long ponytail braided hair was nearly touching the floor behind her.
As for Gaia, she was now human but was rocking her pirate hat, which was funny, considering she looked nothing like an old pirate.
They had no aura, meaning they were mortal. This made people quickly conclude that they were perhaps his sisters or servants.

But they leaned more toward servants, considering you can’t just bring your entire family into the sect. Maids and servants are allowed, though—two at most for inner disciples and three for core disciples.
Kent stopped just before stepping inside the Arena and turned to his master, waving. Of course, his eyes met Ingrid’s, and he gave her a teasing wink.
He recognized her instantly but didn’t say much.

"Akira, you and Gaia should go and stay with Master. Be sure to cheer hard since you two and Master are my only fans." The two lolis nodded and ran toward Saintess Selene, making everyone who saw them want to steal them from Kent.
They were just too cute.
Of course, he didn’t want to risk it, so he didn’t bring Li Hua, who would have equally made everyone want to kidnap her—literally, lol.
Kent stepped inside the Arena and smiled at the Elder, who was giving him the "You are one arrogant bastard" look.
Kent bit into his apple and started chewing while he waited for the noise to die down. When the last person stopped talking, he looked toward the Gate Master.
"Sorry for being late. I was training and lost track of time."
The Gate Master didn’t answer him. She turned to the Elder who would oversee the trial, and he immediately knew what had to be done.
"Challenger Kent, do you have something to say, seeing this might as well be your last day as a cultivator and a swordsman?"
The ridicule in his voice said it all... They were not placing him in their eyes. Which was normal, but Kent was offended in a way. Of course, he was a dragon, and all dragons pride themselves.
Kent sighed and looked around the Arena, choosing his words wisely.
"First of all, shouldn’t I be called Disciple Kent? I mean, I am the disciple of Saintess Selene, after none of you losers managed to become one."
Kent’s words immediately made him stand under thousands of killing intents. Of course, he just shrugged it off and continued his speech.

"But I don’t blame you all. After all, I am just the arrogant bastard who has a death wish, so I chose to challenge the sect. I get it; I may appear more handsome than you all, but when it comes to the sword path, I have no equal at the same rank.
I am not looking down on you, fine swordsmen; I just don’t see any of you winning this battle that’s to come.
Of course, you can call it a bluff, which you will find out soon enough." The more Kent spoke, the angrier people became.
But Kent wasn’t wasting his words. No, he was completing a quest he had received a few minutes after he woke up from his breakthrough.
He turned toward the Gate Master...
"This is what is going to happen here today... I, Kent Madson, the first and only disciple of the Sword Saintess, will defeat your finest swordsmen within 10 hours.
I won’t take any breaks between battles.

Of course, I wouldn’t want you all to lose face, so I won’t draw my sword either. It’s already too shameless for me to challenge Grandmaster swordsmen; I wouldn’t want to affect their Will (Heart / Dao Heart), too.
But fear not. I wouldn’t look down on any of the disciples, even after I defeated them. After all, I don’t discriminate; I only deliver."
Kent smiled because he felt a powerful killing intent lock onto him when he finished his sentence. It was the killing intent coming from the Gate Master, which meant his quest had been successful.
[Congratulations, you have completed your quest: Enrage The Gate Master. Rewards have been deposited into the Tower Storage.]

Kent had received a quest that required him to use his words to enrage the Gate Master and make her release killing intent. In fact, the quest came with a penalty—if he had failed to complete it before the battles began, he would lose access to sword qi.
So, though he meant every word he said, he was also panicking inwardly. Thankfully, he managed to accomplish his goal.
But at a cost.
Everyone hated him now.
Even the Gate Master genuinely hated him to the bone, and if that wasn’t enough, even Spear Saintess Neomi changed her opinion of him.
However, Saintess Selene was still smiling, knowing Kent was perhaps doing something important.
Vexthra had already told her that, in all things, she should trust Kent, for he wouldn’t do anything without a reason.
Kent looked at the elder, who was seething in anger. "No offense, senior, but I had to warn them. Now, if you don’t mind, can we get this show on the road?"
After saying that, Kent took a dark gold mask that covered his eyes to his nose and wore it. It was one of the rewards of the quest, and its only function was to make him look cool.

As expected, the moment he wore the mask, he became much cooler. He stood, holding his sword inside the golden sheath. It was the sheath he won at the auction that made Saintess Selene follow him home.
The sword was the soul weapon Vexthra made for him.

The elder looked at him for a few seconds before calling the first opponent. He was a young man at Level 4 Root Saint Stage. He was a dual-wielder, and looking at his darkened expression, he wanted only one thing.
To cut Kent’s head off.
