chapters.title: Chapter 180: He is a Monster (1)
paragraphs: Kent stood facing his opponent, Liam.
Liam held two short swords, staring back at Kent with eyes filled with fury. He wanted to knock him out in the first exchange, but until the elder started the battle, he simply stood still.
"Death is not permanent, but the pain is real, so don’t worry," the elder said, looking at Kent with eyes filled with pity.
Kent scoffed and crossed his arms over his chest, appearing as nonchalant as could be. He couldn’t care less how Liam would respond to his provocation.
In his eyes, which are literally enchanted, he could tell Liam was just a sheep at the slaughter. He could kill him with his eyes closed.
"Since you both are ready... fight!"

The moment the elder said that Liam moved and instantly appeared in front of Kent. His right sword stabbed toward Kent’s chest while his left swung toward his neck. It was quick and decisive; however, it was just that.
Kent subtly moved his body gracefully and evaded both attacks, still keeping his arms crossed.

In response, Liam attacked again, swinging his left sword while stabbing with the right. This time, Kent simply jumped back and walked to his right. It was a casual walk, but it was quick and effortless.
"You might want to put your back into it if you want to scratch me," Kent said with a laugh, moving to appear two meters away from Liam.

Liam wasn’t offended, knowing Kent was merely taunting him, but his ego remained high. Determined, he moved in for close combat, stabbing, swinging, and jabbing at Kent, who effortlessly dodged every attack.
Fifty seconds later, Kent was still evading all of Liam’s attacks with his eyes closed. This sight infuriated almost everyone. Kent is too arrogant. But he had the strength to back it up.
Since Liam treated him like a nobody, believing he could win in close combat without even using his sword aura, Kent decided to end it.
"Here comes the pain," Kent said.

He sidestepped a stabbing attack, then, as if kicking a ball, his right leg swung and landed a solid kick on Liam’s ribs, cracking a few and sending him flying out of the arena. Liam landed unconscious outside the boundary.
Kent hadn’t put much energy into the kick, but it was heavy enough to knock Liam out. Glancing at the unconscious opponent, who was bleeding from the corner of his lips, Kent smirked.
"Weak."
His words reached the ears of most people, turning their shocked expressions into fury. This immediately enraged all the opponents he would be facing.
Without even being called, the next opponent stepped into the arena, ready to battle Kent. The elder didn’t say anything and simply chose to start the battle.
"Fight!"

Immediately after the elder spoke, the new opponent, a single longsword wielder just like Kent, moved, channeling his sword qi. He appeared two meters from Kent, and unlike Liam, this one went for the kill right off the bat.
"Twin Sword Strike!"

His sword aura formed into two sharp blades and stabbed at Kent with powerful strength supporting it. The two swords arrived immediately in front of Kent, but just as they were about to land on his body, Kent blinked away.
He appeared behind his opponent, named Cliff, and kicked out at his ribs. Just like what happened to Liam, Cliff was also sent flying out of the arena.
Luckily for him, he only cracked a few ribs but didn’t lose consciousness.
However, the shocked expression on his face said it all. The kick was heavy, and had it not been for Kent holding back, he would have been broken in half by now.
Thankfully, Kent wasn’t putting much effort into the battle, considering he was confident in his kicks and attacks.
Kent looked in the direction of the opponents, all seated in the same place except for the five disciples of the gate master, and made a "Come get me" gesture, further enraging them.𝘧𝓇ℯℯ𝑤ℯ𝘣𝓃ℴ𝓋𝑒𝑙.𝑐𝘰𝑚
As expected, the third opponent, this time a lady, jumped into the arena, holding her thin sword while another hovered beside her.

She looked toward Kent and made a killing gesture, showing that she was a lady but wasn’t acting like one. Kent smiled and firmly planted his foot on the ground, silently telling her what was about to happen.
She frowned, but when the elder started the battle, she attacked with her flying sword and followed it up with a powerful strike.
"24 String Weaving Strike!"
Kent recognized the technique all too well. He can use it because he has mastered and upgraded it...
Twelve strings of sword qi attacked Kent, who used his blink skill to evade, leaving not even a trace of his presence behind. The attack was useless, but Kent was also disappointed.
Why?
Because the attack just now was simply too weak. According to his master, the [24 String Weaving Strike] was supposed to be a powerful skill that every sword disciple was allowed to learn.

Of course, when his master mentioned that many couldn’t master all 24 strings, he thought she was just exaggerating. It took him just a few seconds to learn and master it, so saying it can take others years was just stretching it.
But it seemed she was telling the truth...
...Kent, who had effortlessly evaded her attack, could have sent her flying, but for some reason, he wanted to show everyone what true sword genius looks like.
It was like he was feeling pathetic looking at the weak display he had faced already. They all don’t appear like how a swordsman should be.
So he finally spread his arms and held the sword sheath in the middle, demonstrating that he had no need to draw his sword, as he had promised.
At the same time, Erin, the lady he was facing, attacked with her flying sword, but Kent simply swatted it away with his sword still inside the sheath.
Strangely, when the sword landed, it broke in half. Of course, Kent had put some strength into it, considering the flying sword was packing some force.
Erin was taken aback, but before she could recover, she heard Kent speak.
"Because I am better than you all, why don’t I show you the true form of the [24 String Weaving Strike]?"
Kent smirked, still holding the sword at its center, and made a striking gesture. Suddenly, 24 thick strings made of Sword Qi flashed out from his sword, forming a deadly net.
Each string was razor-sharp and looked incredibly dangerous and deadly. Also, the strings are clean and beautiful to the eye.
The moment the attack appeared, Erin froze in place and even closed her eyes, certain she was about to be cut to pieces.

However, just before the attack could slice through her, Kent appeared beside her and landed a gentle kick on her back. It wasn’t enough to injure her severely, but it was heavy enough to send her flying out of harm’s way.
She landed outside the arena.
Kent’s intent flared, and when the attack landed on him, it created a powerful shockwave, but he was unharmed—not even a single cut.
At that very moment, everyone inside the arena finally woke from their trance and saw Kent for who he truly was.

The Gate Master was no exception. She had just witnessed Kent use the true form of the infamous [24 String Weaving Strike], and it was exactly as she remembered it when she first mastered it as a Sword Saint.
Now, as a Sword Sage, she could see it clearly—and it was perfect.
She turned toward Saintess Selene, who was smiling back at her. As if savoring the moment, Selene smirked and spoke words that sounded arrogant, but to all who heard them, they rang true.
"That is my disciple, Gate Master. He mastered this skill within seconds, and the very next day, he upgraded it to 36 strings.
Naturally, I think he has already surpassed 36—but who’s counting?"
Her words brought the Gate Master to a moment of clarity. In that instant, she understood one thing and one thing only:
None of the disciples would be able to defeat Kent—not even her own disciples.

chapters.title: Chapter 181: He is a Monster (2)
paragraphs: A disciple was sent flying out of the arena, landing on the ground with a heavy thud.

He was the 67th disciple Kent had sent flying, and he wouldn’t be the last. Shockingly, it had been less than two hours since the start of the battle, yet more than half had already lost and were being tended to.
Kent was, in a way, disappointed.
He came out of the Tower with expectations, but things wouldn’t get any better from what he was sensing. Of course, he knew they were saving the best for last.
But even a blind man could tell that it wouldn’t amount to anything, no matter the surprise they were planning. Kent was just too powerful and talented to have Sword Grandmasters as his opponents.
"He is a monster," a disciple in the audience said. And he wasn’t the only one thinking the same thing. Even the Sect Elders had the same thoughts. It was as if Kent had shattered their expectations.

"You know, when I heard the disciple of Saintess Selene had challenged the entire inner section of the sect, I thought maybe he had a few screws loose. But damn, this handsome guy is very powerful," a lady disciple everyone knew as Loudmouth said.
Nobody said anything against her words, knowing she was telling the truth. Nobody had expected Kent to be this monstrous. In fact, nobody had even expected him to last a single match.
But as it stood, he was on track to becoming the first person to win the Trial of the Sword.

"At this point, would anyone even be able to contend against him? None of them lasted even five minutes, and aside from the technique he used in the third match, he hasn’t used any others," a disciple said, shaking his head. "This trial is as good as won at this point."
While everyone was engaged in their discussions, the 68th person was sent flying in under 60 seconds. Kent wasn’t tired or anything...
The only skill he was using was [Blink].
At the moment, he was simply invincible. His opponents tried their most powerful techniques on him, but none even managed to scratch him. It was as if he had transcended the realm of common sense.
Just when their attacks were mere inches from his body, he would vanish and reappear behind them.
Many of them tried to use this pattern to their advantage, but after repeated failures, they stopped and accepted that they would not win.

Forty minutes later, 90 disciples had been sent flying. By this point, Kent had become a celebrity, with everyone forgetting his earlier arrogant remarks. However, they still hated him for the image he had now taken on.
The two lolis, who were surprisingly good with their words, elevated his image even further. They were singing Kent’s praises like the most loyal fans would.
"Akira, I think at this point Master should just sit down and let the rest attack him for an hour... They strike like babies," Gaia said with a mocking expression.

"I know, right? The last time we sparred with Master, we were even able to push him back 30 meters... I say Master should just take a nap and wake up five hours later; they wouldn’t even be able to draw a drop of blood," Akira said, firing back, making people want to strangle them.
"Master’s Master, don’t you think Master is awesome?" Akira turned to Saintess Selene, who was very happy at the moment. Her disciple was making her proud.

"Your master who is my disciple is indeed awesome. I am afraid I will soon become his disciple..." Saintess Selene said those words, looking at Saintess Neomi while casting a subtle glance at the Gate Master.
For some reason, the two ladies understood what she meant. One was amused and even blushed slightly, while the other gritted her teeth and looked at the strongest of her disciples.
"Zhen, go and handle that brat."
Zhen, a short, dark-haired beauty with cute, big eyes and pale skin, stood up holding two swords. She is a level 7 Root Saint and has both Sword Intent and Sword Aura.
Among the five disciples of the Gate Master, she is the strongest. She is also one of the many beauties in the sect and the entire Althea Kingdom.

Naturally, she had been yearning to fight, as they all had, so when she got the chance, she immediately took it. Using her sword, she floated in the air and landed inside the arena, making everyone go wild.
Even Kent was impressed by her entrance.
Of course, he scanned her and was surprised to see she had mastered both Sword Intent and Sword Qi to the Enhanced stage and was already halfway to the Profound Sword Qi and Intent stage.
"You are Kent, right? You can call me Zhen, and remember my name when you’re tossed on the street after getting crippled," Zhen said.
Her Sword Aura and Intent burst out as soon as she finished, filling the arena with its sharpness.
Kent raised an eyebrow when he sensed his clothes being cut as more and more of her aura began filling the arena.

Naturally, he didn’t wear any of the clothes Vexthra made for him; he was just in something casual he bought back in Caprath City. If he wore anything from Vexthra, not even a cut would have appeared on the fabric.𝑓𝘳𝑒𝑒𝓌𝘦𝘣𝘯ℴ𝑣𝘦𝑙.𝘤𝑜𝑚
But he wasn’t worried.
He just looked at the Gate Master and winked at her before speaking.

"It will be best if you handle her with care after this match; her Dao heart may be affected." The moment the Gate Master heard those words, her heartbeat froze. She wanted to say something, but Kent didn’t allow her.
He took a step forward, and his Sword Intent exploded out.
He took another step, and his Sword Qi also exploded. By the time he took the third step, Zhen’s presence was erased from the arena.
Kent didn’t hold back this time and went for the kill.
His Sword Qi formed into countless razor-sharp air blades, cutting her into many pieces. It all happened instantly.
Before anyone could witness it, it was over.
Zhen respawned outside the arena and immediately passed out. The Gate Master appeared beside her disciple but was already gone when she arrived.
Kent didn’t even spare them a glance. His aura and intent were still active, so he turned to those yet to face him.
"Those who want to win, just step into the arena. If you manage to last for 3 seconds, I will make it your win."

His words were arrogant, but they presented an opportunity. The young swordsman, named Max, moved, and the next second, he stepped into the arena. However, a moment later, he was outside and passed out.

Nobody, aside from a few elders, the Saintesses, and the Gate Master with a few core disciples, knew what had happened. Of course, the opponent knew as well, but they couldn’t even explain how it occurred.
Another disciple, one of the Gate Master’s disciples, jumped in, but he met the same fate. When the third person fell into Kent’s trap, the Gate Master finally had enough.
"Everyone stop. This trial is over, and the winner is Kent Madson. From now on, he should be recognized as an inner disciple of this sect and the official disciple of the Sword Saintess."
After saying that, she took her two disciples away, but she used a method to transmit a few words to Kent...
’I will see you later, brat... this is not over.’

chapters.title: Chapter 182: Monster Of The Sword Gate
paragraphs: (A/N: I know some of you were expecting a longer battle scene. Sorry to disappoint, but the MC is simply too OP to go up against Grandmaster Swordsmen. It feels like bullying, crushing their dreams and aspirations like that.
That’s why I’ll make it up to you all in the coming Chapters. Just don’t laugh or cry too much... It’s just a story, after all... lol.😂😂😂)

Word of Kent’s feat in the Trial of the Sword spread rapidly throughout the Divine Palace Sect. It was the only topic on everyone’s lips—and it had been less than a day since he defeated all 100 Grandmaster Swordsmen.
No matter the gate within the sect, Kent was currently elated. In fact, his fame had skyrocketed beyond the walls of the sect.
Some disciples even recorded the battles on their recording crystals and began sharing them among themselves.
The greedy ones are even selling to those outside the sect. This is huge news worth spreading at the Kingdom level.

The Spear Gate, which had a longstanding rivalry with the Sword Gate, had already started ridiculing the Sword Gate, leading to a few clashes among disciples. Of course, the Elders intervened and broke up the fights before they could escalate.
But that doesn’t mean the matter has died down...
In fact, Kent’s feat has changed many things in the sect. It was as if his presence had altered everything people believed.
A Level 8 Root Grandmaster somehow managed to defeat 100 Grandmaster swordsmen, all of whom are Root Saints. That just doesn’t make sense.
In fact, it shouldn’t make sense... But it also means that, although the Sword Gate has faced an unfortunate defeat, they now have a monster they can rely on.
Someone they can use to brag about...
So, the other gates have to strike while the iron is still hot. If they waste time, things will escalate beyond their current limits.
Kent must be put in his place before his ego grows too big.
Just like that, the gate masters began meeting with their gate elders, searching for a way to curb the growing threat within the Sword Gate...

One would think a sect should be united, but they are all schemers who only know how to backstab one another. Kent had proven to be a threat they couldn’t ignore, so they sought to put him in his place.
But while this was happening, outside the Divine Palace Sect, some people who had watched the recordings began spreading the word.
One of these videos found its way to the Everlasting Immortal Sword Sect, the number one sword sect in the entire Althea Kingdom and possibly the entire human continent.
"I trust you’ve all seen the video," a white-bearded man said, his gaze shifting to three others. Two were men, and the last was a woman, likely in her late 40s.
"They’re calling him the Monster of the Sword Gate," said the white-bearded man. He was Clyde, the Sect Master of the Everlasting Immortal Sword Sect.

"This doesn’t look good for us. Not only did he refrain from drawing his sword, but he also managed to execute the infamous [24 String Weaving Strike] flawlessly. This kid is indeed a monster," the woman named Cecil said, still watching the video.

"This doesn’t bode well for us indeed. With this kid, the next Kingdom Genius Competition won’t be in our favour," one of the men in the room, Josh, said, glaring daggers at the image of Kent projected from the recording crystal.
These crystals are used to record events, much like recording cameras on Earth.

"Then what should we do? Although he’s not yet at the level of our Core Disciples, if he’s given a few years to grow, he won’t just surpass them—he’ll surpass us," the last man in the room, Bai, added.
Negative thoughts began forming in their minds. They just didn’t want to lose. They were the Everlasting Immortal Sword Sect, one of the most powerful sects on the human continent.
They prided themselves on being one of the most powerful sects with a great understanding of the path of the sword. However, Kent’s display shook their hearts.
If Kent wasn’t taken care of, things would come crashing down for them.

After all, the last time they lost the Kingdom Genius Competition was many years ago, and even back then, it was the current Sword Gate Master, who was known back in the day as the Sword Fairy, who won that competition.
Since then, nobody has come close to claiming that title from them. But Kent had just proven that the title could be claimed—and easily at that.
If someone manages to execute such a powerful sword skill flawlessly, it means only one thing: he is a genius who cannot be ignored.

"There are only two things we can do," Sect Master Clyde said. "We can either try to bring him to our side or kill him secretly. He cannot be allowed to grow. While he may be the disciple of the Sword Saintess, his growth must be stopped if he is not on our side."
The three elders exchanged looks. "Then how should we go about it? Do we send someone to recruit him, or should we go straight to killing him?" Elder Cecil asked.

"Let’s send Sword Saintess Val. She and Sword Saintess Selene are rivals. If we send her, we can easily determine the best course of action. I doubt the other sects will just stand idle once they see this," Clyde said, looking at the three.
"She can do as she pleases, since no matter what we tell her, she won’t listen. So let’s just give her this chance. She can act freely while she’s there."
The three elders nodded, and the meeting concluded.

What Kent doesn’t know is that in this world, titles and status mean everything. He is currently on everyone’s radar, so no matter what, he will attract attention—and with attention, people will try to suppress him.
If he proves stubborn, they will try to kill him.
Powerful factions and families will undoubtedly start vying for him, offering all kinds of enticing rewards. Without a doubt, other kingdoms will also notice him and come after him.
Being a genius in Sonox comes with many ups and downs, and Kent has just found himself caught in one.
Unfortunately for many, they aren’t aware that the dragon they are after is, in fact, a powerful yet arrogant creature.

Legend had it that the Chaos Dragon was the most arrogant and deadly among all dragons. Kent, who was now in the process of becoming a Chaos Dragon, was slowly moving in that direction, where he would one day become truly dangerous.
Unfortunately, nobody knew his true identity or strength, so they clung to their arrogance and hoped they could become the ones to suppress the dragon.
They might be on the right track—considering that if they do come after Kent, they might indeed have a shot.
But sadly, they are running out of time. That is because, before parting ways with Uncle Drew, he gave his most trusted servant, the captain of the Night Riders, a mission.
While it was a mission for Uncle Drew, it was, in fact, a quest for Kent. And this quest came with something crucial. The moment Kent gets his hands on it, he will become incredibly dangerous.
Back when he went to rescue Li Hua from Mokasa Prison, he was attacked by a Root Sage who wanted to make him her slave.

However, one thing led to another, and he killed her instead. Later, it was discovered that he may have awakened a past self through reincarnation, which was the reason he managed to kill the Root Sage.
And now, once Uncle Drew and the Night Riders complete the mission, Kent will receive a Memory key that will unlock a part of his past memories.
In just a few days from now, Kent will unlock a fragment of his past—a memory of himself as a powerful existence that once shook the hearts and souls of immortals...

chapters.title: Chapter 183: Did You Force Her
paragraphs: Two days had passed since the Trial of the Swords.
The sect was still abuzz with talk about the event. However, the person at the center of it all was currently meditating under a tree in Saintess Selene’s mini-mansion.
Right after the battle, Kent, disappointed by the lackluster performance of the disciples, chose to meditate in an attempt to cleanse himself of the disgust he felt.
He didn’t know why, but for some reason, his expectations of what the duels should have been were utterly shattered.
Although he had won and even completed the quest, he didn’t feel like a winner at all.
It was like one of those stories where an immortal who founded the sects one day sees a disciple from his own sect and feels an overwhelming sense of disappointment.
That was exactly how Kent was feeling now.
His expectation was not met, so he chose to calm his mind first in order not to cause more damage than he had already caused.
He is walking the Genesis path, so as someone walking the first original path of the sword, he wasn’t pleased with the performance of the disciples.
He craves a worthy opponent...For that is the path of the Genesis Swordsman.
For the past two days, he had been meditating.
Meanwhile, a day ago, the Gate Master came to visit, but Saintess Selene didn’t allow her. She told her that her disciple was currently unavailable.
This didn’t sit well with the Gate Master, but she couldn’t do anything about it. So, she left and planned to come back later.
Kent had messed up her disciples, and for that, she needed an excuse to get back at him.
Naturally, she was only doing this because she had lost—and brutally at that. Kent would have to up his game here if he wanted to tap that ass.
Saintess Neomi and her disciple Ingrid had left right after the trial. Kent’s performance had been too overwhelming to comprehend, so they needed some space to think.
Of course, the shameless Saintess had invited them, and they accepted, agreeing to come the next day.
It had been two days, but they hadn’t returned yet.
Finally, at 7 p.m. on the second day, Ingrid and her master arrived for a visit, and Saintess Selene welcomed them with great enthusiasm.

"Where is your disciple? I want to talk to him," Saintess Neomi demanded, her voice firm. Selene simply smiled and stepped aside to let her pass. Saintess Neomi isn’t about to let this slide. Kent had violated her sister...Well, that’s what she is telling herself.
As for Saintess Selene, she had some things to discuss with Ingrid anyway.
Saintess Neomi passed and headed to where Kent was meditating. When she arrived, she saw Kent lying on his back, casually chewing on an apple.
"You look comfortable," she said, observing him.
Kent, who had already known she was coming thanks to his master’s warning, stood up and looked at the beautiful Spear Saintess, who was staring daggers at him.
"You must be Master’s big sister," Kent said with a smile. "I’m Kent Madson, but you can just call me Kent—or Kenny, if you want."
Saintess Neomi didn’t say anything; she just kept staring at Kent for a full five minutes before finally asking a question.
"Did you force her?"
"I don’t know what you’re talking about," Kent responded with an innocent expression. Of course, he knew what she was talking about; he just didn’t want to end the conversation that quickly.
"Don’t play coy with me, Kent. I know my sister, and she would never have given her innocence to any man. So, what did you do to her?" she asked again, releasing a strand of her killing intent.
"And you’d better choose your words carefully. I might not kill you, but there are a lot of bad things I can do to you."
Kent smiled, watching her cold expression.

[Looks like you’ve got yourself another Tigress master. That gate master is a certified tigress, and now you have yet another one. I guess it’s only normal, considering you’ve been surrounded by cats ever since you arrived in this world.]
Kent, who was about to say something, choked on his words as Gaia’s shameless voice echoed in his head.

Gaia had already told him that her personality would shift based on the tower she was linked to. Now, with her speaking through the Harem Tower, she was both perverted and shameless, just as expected.
Kent steadied his expression before replying.
"I did not force her. I simply made my desires known, and she couldn’t resist. After all, she chose me as her disciple—she might have already anticipated this outcome."
Kent wasn’t about to admit how he had come to have indeed shared an intimate moment with Selene.
He might not have forced her, but he most certainly hadn’t let her slip through his fingers. In the end, she overcame her trauma and was now genuinely happy.
"So, you are telling me this was mutual?" Saintess Neomi asked.
"Definitely mutual. We both wanted it, and we went for it. Now, everyone is happy," Kent replied before standing up.
"If you are here to find out why she chose to become my woman, then know that I promise to make her happy, and I mean every word I say.

Now, it’s up to you to decide whether you want to do something to me and make her sad or let her remain happy. Since you are her sister and practically her guardian, I promise you I won’t make her sad."
Saintess Neomi nodded. She had expected as much, but she still wanted to see through his words. So far, it’s either Kent is a good liar, or he meant every word he just said.
"Then what are your intentions toward my disciple? I know you have something to do with her recent behavior."
Saintess Selene had noticed how surprised Ingrid was when she saw him enter the Arena two days ago. While she may be disconnected from the rest of the world, she wasn’t stupid.
She knew something had happened between them, and from how Ingrid had been pressuring her to come to the Sword Gate over the past two days, she was certain it was to see Kent.

Additionally, she could tell that Selene and Ingrid had become very close, which was puzzling. While Selene had always been somewhat close to Ingrid, they never truly hung out or spent more than ten minutes talking with each other before.
But now, they had become close—practically best friends.
In fact, just yesterday, she overheard Ingrid talking to Saintess Selene through their communication tokens. It was as if they had suddenly become inseparable.
This puzzled her.
She wasn’t jealous of their budding relationship; rather, she was surprised by how lively her sister had become. It’s a new change she must accept.
"What can I say? She saw something with those Void Eyes of hers, and now she wants to feel what she saw," Kent replied with a chuckle.
Saintess Neomi, however, didn’t immediately reply to him. Instead, she stared at Kent for a full five minutes. Kent had just mentioned something that was known by only one person—her.
Ingrid’s Void Eyes.
That was a closely guarded secret, yet Kent seemed to know about it.
"How do you know she has Void Eyes?" Saintess Neomi asked, pulling out a spear and pointing it at Kent, who merely stood there, smiling at her.
"That’s because I also have similar eyes. That’s how I know you’re just pretending with the spear..." Kent chuckled and bit into his apple.

chapters.title: Chapter 184: Unexpected Chain Quest
paragraphs: Saintess Neomi stared at Kent for a few minutes, then she lowered her spear and put it away. She sighed and looked into his eyes.
"You can’t tell anyone about her eyes. This world is a dangerous place, and if people find out she has Void Eyes, she will be targeted... even by kings."

Vexthra had told Kent that Sonox was not a normal medium-level world. In fact, she even mentioned that she was from this world, and just like the path Kent was about to walk, he would have to rise through the world by ascending at every turn.
However, she never explained what made Sonox, unlike every other world.
After all, it had been millions of years since she left, ascended to a high world, and later became a goddess. Now, however, Kent was beginning to understand some things.

"If you don’t mind, can I know why people would target her? She is a core disciple; wouldn’t the sect protect her?" Kent asked. "I mean, someone with such a powerful eye shouldn’t be taken lightly, right?"
When Kent first met Ingrid, the tower hadn’t awakened back then, so he had only managed to identify the name of her eyes. But now that it had awakened, he knew much more.
However, the way Saintess Neomi was saying it implied that the sect wasn’t the right place for her. Damn, even the kingdom as a whole wasn’t the right place for her.

"Your master has probably warned you about something, but it seems she did a poor job. Now, I want you to listen to me and listen carefully... In this world, especially in this sect, you can’t just trust anyone.
In fact, you are currently in big trouble. The prowess you’ve shown during the trial will attract all kinds of attention, and while some may come with good intentions, you shouldn’t trust them.
Everyone who approaches you, in one way or another, will be after your talent. If they get their hands on you, that will be the end for you. Not even the sect can help you...

Believe it or not, some people in this sect would rather pull you down than see you succeed. You don’t understand yet, but this world is all about who is stronger, who has the most power, and who controls the most resources.

Having a wild card with overwhelming prowess running around is not something anyone would want. In fact, the only thing you will experience from now on is the constant scheming of those who want you gone.
"Even if you have the backing of the sect, who’s to say those you trust won’t stab you in the back? In this world, you cannot let just anyone in on your secret.
My disciple is special, and so, aside from me, not even her family is aware of her Void Eyes... Well, I guess now it’s just you, me, and her who know this."
"I see. Then rest assured I won’t tell anyone of her unique set of eyes. After all, I wouldn’t want to put the disciples of masters sister to get into trouble," Kent said, making Saintess Neomi nod.
In truth, had Kent not been the disciple of her sister, she would, without a doubt, drive her spear through his heart.
Ingrid’s eyes are very special, in fact.

The Void’s eyes on her make her one of the scariest people out there. Though Kent didn’t know just how deeply she had mastered her void eyes, the tower gave him details that made him want to get some, too.
The Void eyes are a special set of eyes only a race of beings that had long gone instinct possesses.
The Voidlings.
They are a race of body cultivation that specialises in mind cultivation. They only cultivate their minds, making them some of the strongest beings with powerful mental abilities.
They use their eyes as a conduit to harness their mind attacks.

Of course, one can say they are normal in a way, but Voidlings are perhaps one of the most unkillable beings in the cosmos. They possess a unique energy called the Energy of the Void. Basically, they have a unique affinity to the Void.
So, while she could see through formations and even thicker walls, that was just a natural part of her Void Eyes.
In fact, if she manages to upgrade her mind to the next level after the initial steps, she will become someone who can use just her mind to bring down an entire army.
Looking into her eyes will make one’s heart tremble and break minds. She is very scary, to say the least.
’How I wish there was a way to acquire those eyes’, Kent sighed, but then his eyes widened when a message appeared.
⟪ You have received a Quest from the Universe Quest Pool ⟫
⟪ Quest Name: Get On Her Good Side...and Then Her Pants [18+] ⟫
⟪ Quest Type: Chain ⟫
⟪ Quest Difficulty: Depends on your game ⟫
⟪ Quest Description: : > ⟫
-> The Spear Saintess still doesn’t trust you despite sparing you this time. She remains uncertain about how to feel toward you, so you must take up this challenge.
-> In the coming days, weeks, months, and even years, you will receive quests that come with multiple rewards.
-> All you need to do is get on her good side and, eventually, win her over completely. Are you brave enough to take up this challenge?

Kent, of course, was ready for a challenge, mainly due to how unexpected his welcome to the sect had been. In fact, he had expected a much warmer reception.
But that didn’t mean he wasn’t thrilled by what he had been through. Though mundane, it had excited him, so he chose to continue.
For now, he would find a way to become her friend, aiming to get into her good graces—or perhaps more.

sentences.text: Saintess Neomi stared at Kent for a few minutes, then she lowered her spear and put it away.
She sighed and looked into his eyes.
"You can’t tell anyone about her eyes.
This world is a dangerous place, and if people find out she has Void Eyes, she will be targeted... even by kings."
Vexthra had told Kent that Sonox was not a normal medium-level world.
In fact, she even mentioned that she was from this world, and just like the path Kent was about to walk, he would have to rise through the world by ascending at every turn.
However, she never explained what made Sonox, unlike every other world.
After all, it had been millions of years since she left, ascended to a high world, and later became a goddess.
Now, however, Kent was beginning to understand some things.
"If you don’t mind, can I know why people would target her?
She is a core disciple; wouldn’t the sect protect her?" Kent asked.
"I mean, someone with such a powerful eye shouldn’t be taken lightly, right?"
When Kent first met Ingrid, the tower hadn’t awakened back then, so he had only managed to identify the name of her eyes.
But now that it had awakened, he knew much more.
However, the way Saintess Neomi was saying it implied that the sect wasn’t the right place for her.
Damn, even the kingdom as a whole wasn’t the right place for her.
"Your master has probably warned you about something, but it seems she did a poor job.
Now, I want you to listen to me and listen carefully...
In this world, especially in this sect, you can’t just trust anyone.
In fact, you are currently in big trouble.
The prowess you’ve shown during the trial will attract all kinds of attention, and while some may come with good intentions, you shouldn’t trust them.
Everyone who approaches you, in one way or another, will be after your talent.
If they get their hands on you, that will be the end for you.
Not even the sect can help you...
Believe it or not, some people in this sect would rather pull you down than see you succeed.
You don’t understand yet, but this world is all about who is stronger, who has the most power, and who controls the most resources.
Having a wild card with overwhelming prowess running around is not something anyone would want.
In fact, the only thing you will experience from now on is the constant scheming of those who want you gone.
"Even if you have the backing of the sect, who’s to say those you trust won’t stab you in the back?
In this world, you cannot let just anyone in on your secret.
My disciple is special, and so, aside from me, not even her family is aware of her Void Eyes...
Well, I guess now it’s just you, me, and her who know this."
"I see.
Then rest assured I won’t tell anyone of her unique set of eyes.
After all, I wouldn’t want to put the disciples of masters sister to get into trouble," Kent said, making Saintess Neomi nod.
In truth, had Kent not been the disciple of her sister, she would, without a doubt, drive her spear through his heart.
Ingrid’s eyes are very special, in fact.
The Void’s eyes on her make her one of the scariest people out there.
Though Kent didn’t know just how deeply she had mastered her void eyes, the tower gave him details that made him want to get some, too.
The Void eyes are a special set of eyes only a race of beings that had long gone instinct possesses.
The Voidlings.
They are a race of body cultivation that specialises in mind cultivation.
They only cultivate their minds, making them some of the strongest beings with powerful mental abilities.
They use their eyes as a conduit to harness their mind attacks.
Of course, one can say they are normal in a way, but Voidlings are perhaps one of the most unkillable beings in the cosmos.
They possess a unique energy called the Energy of the Void.
Basically, they have a unique affinity to the Void.
So, while she could see through formations and even thicker walls, that was just a natural part of her Void Eyes.
In fact, if she manages to upgrade her mind to the next level after the initial steps, she will become someone who can use just her mind to bring down an entire army.
Looking into her eyes will make one’s heart tremble and break minds.
She is very scary, to say the least.
’How I wish there was a way to acquire those eyes’, Kent sighed, but then his eyes widened when a message appeared.

chapters.title: Chapter 185: Chaotic Friendship
paragraphs: When Kent received the [Enchanted Eyes], he was able to use them to view the stats, threat level, and certain details about people, objects, and places. This ability was made possible thanks to the Enchantress Book he had absorbed.
However, as his soul strength grew and he gained significant boosts from his lovers, he began to perceive entirely new aspects of the world.
One of these new abilities is the ability to see Intent (Intention).
Kent can now perceive someone’s intent in percentage form. Initially, he didn’t understand how it worked, but he discovered the pattern through careful observation during duels.
Anything from 0% to 30% is considered neutral. From 30% to 50% indicates danger, and anything above 50% signifies an intent to kill.
It was the reason Kent was able to tell that Saintess Neomi wasn’t planning to kill him when she drew her spear. He glanced at her Intent Meter and saw that it was low.
However, when he made his intentions toward her disciple known, her Intent Meter shot up to 52%. As a result, Kent endured a few minutes of relentless beatings, leaving him with several broken bones.
A short while ago, Saintess Selene and Ingrid were discussing matters related to Kent. Selene was sharing details about how she met him and even disclosed their intimate relationship.
Ingrid was initially shocked but quickly composed herself. However, her curiosity was piqued, and she began asking a flurry of questions.
Of course, Selene was happy to talk, for she knew what she was doing.
However, a few minutes into her speech, they heard a scream, followed by another scream. This forced them to pocket their conversation and rush out to see what was happening.
It was then that they saw Kent getting thrashed by Saintess Neomi, who was using nothing but her hands. Kent’s right arm was bent at an unnatural angle, and his left leg was in the same condition.
The two ladies froze for a moment, and they could only watch as the usually calm Spear Saintess suddenly resorted to violence.
After five minutes of beatings, she stopped, retrieved a healing potion from her space ring, and made Kent drink it.
"Ouch..."
Kent screamed as Saintess Selene took his arm and bent it back to its natural angle.
"Shut up... are you a baby? Let me fix your leg," Saintess Neomi snapped, smacking the back of his head before straightening his broken leg. She made sure to do it slowly and painfully.
Kent groaned through the pain as he locked eyes with the Spear Saintess, who, for a moment, flashed a small smile before standing up.
"Come visit me after you’ve recovered. I still have some things to talk to you about," Saintess Neomi said, glancing at Ingrid before smiling.
"You can stay here if you want... but stay away from this bastard. He is a snake." After saying that, she took to the skies and left.
Kent stayed on the ground for a few minutes before a small smile appeared on his lips. ’I will definitely get my revenge one day...’
[Friendship Meter: 5/100 Percent]
Those weird and painful moments moved the friendship meter by 5%, which, in Kent’s book, was a successful endeavour.
Saintess Selene quickly rushed to his side to check if he was seriously injured.
"Don’t worry, they’re just minor injuries... nothing my healing abilities can’t fix," Kent assured her. To prove his point, he stood up. Though painful, he wasn’t about to cry like a baby.
He walked around to show her he was all right.
Kent then looked at Ingrid, who was looking back at him and smiled.
"We haven’t officially met. I am Kent, Kent Madson," Kent said, extending his hand for a shake, which Ingrid readily accepted.
Right now, Ingrid didn’t know how to behave around him. The events that led to their meeting were just too shameful.

She had been caught spying on him while he was being intimate with his lover. That was just too embarrassing, to say the least. Now, she was face-to-face with the one she had been spying on and didn’t know how to act.
Saintess Selene watched from the side, a smile playing on her lips.
"Your master is wicked," Kent said, deciding to spare her the teasing today and change the topic.
"I don’t know why she beat you up, but Master is much more reserved and calm," Ingrid replied, defending her master.

"Well, I guess asking her for advice on how to get into her disciple’s pants can make anyone mad," Kent said, making Ingrid freeze up. Kent just smiled, walked closer to his master, and planted a kiss on her lips before turning back to Ingrid.

"You can stay for the next few days, right? I have some things to take care of, and as you can see, I need to recover from your master’s clear physical torture." Kent moved closer to her and held her by the waist.
"We’ll get to know each other more when I recover," he added, ensuring his hand brushed past her ass, making Ingrid’s body stiffen.
Kent just smiled and walked away. He entered the bedroom and lay on the bed. The next second, he vanished into the Arena and reappeared inside the Alchemy Tower in a poison-filled bath.
It was the last herbal bath he had prepared before venturing. He went to practice the swordplays so he could break through. As he began absorbing its effects, he unknowingly drifted into sleep.
Meanwhile, outside, Ingrid was still frozen after Kent had gently massaged her ass. She stood there for a few minutes until Saintess Selene led her away.
"Is he that shameless? We don’t even know each other that well, and he’s already this handsy," Ingrid said, finally calming down as she looked at the smiling Saintess.
"That’s Kent. If he managed to make his master his woman, you can only imagine what he’s capable of," Saintess Selene chuckled, pulling out a sword technique from her space ring.
"Is that a Heaven-Grade Sword Technique?" Ingrid asked, looking at the skill book with interest. One could even see her eyes sparkling as she looked at the skill book.
"Yes." Saintess Selene smiled and took out two more. "Kent bought them for me when he was working his way into my pants."
She held the technique with a defeated smile. "I guess he succeeded. That bastard," she said, her words accompanied by a satisfied smile.
"Don’t worry, I will extort him to get you a few techniques when he is done recovering," Saintess Selene said, looking at Ingrid...
"You make it sound like he has money lying around. Heaven-Grade skills are expensive, you know. Even my master only has one, and that was because she won it in a duel," Ingrid said.

"Yeah, well, Kent is not only handsome, but he’s also very rich... You wouldn’t believe me yet, but wait for him to come out first and see for yourself. My advice to you, however, don’t reject him when he offers. I nearly made that mistake myself."
Ingrid looked at her expression and nodded.
The saintess nodded in return and began learning the [Void Cutter] skill Kent had bought for her in the Green Bazaar, leaving Ingrid to ponder a few life choices.

One had to give it to the Sword Saintess. Her shamelessness was on the same level as Kent’s. She might not like to show her true colours to those she hated, but when it came to those she liked, her hidden demons surfaced.

chapters.title: Chapter 186: Unexpected Revenge (1)
paragraphs: After parting ways with Kent and Uncle Drew, Saden, the second Night Rider who was previously known as Aria, made her way toward the Varyndor Kingdom, where she planned to exact revenge on the one she once thought was her sister.
It turned out she wasn’t, and in the end, Saden ended up with a dagger through her back. It was the classic backstab one would expect from a jealous friend.
Melody... She was practically her sister, but due to her jealousy of Aria—now called Saden after becoming a Night Rider—she colluded with Darren, the aloof heir of the Malric noble family.
Saden just couldn’t understand how it all went downhill, but now she wanted revenge, for she had promised it before becoming a Night Rider.

Riding through the night, she sped toward the Varyndor Kingdom, knowing from what she had overheard before her supposed death that Darren and Melody would be heading to the Althea Kingdom to attend the annual auction and sell the Ten-Year-Old Gold Essence Mushroom.
She wouldn’t let that happen.

Thankfully, in her Night Rider form, she quickly reached the borders of the Varyndor Kingdom and reverted to her human form. But instead of walking with an uncovered face, she donned a mask that obscured her eyes and pulled up a hoodie.

Moving swiftly, she soon found herself outside the mansion of the Malric noble family in Stonehaven. She waited for something to happen, and an hour later, a maid attending to her duties passed by the spot where she was hiding.

Saden used a technique she had learned as a Night Rider to subdue the maid. Then, she extracted the needed information using another skill that allowed her to only place her hand on the maid’s forehead.
When she was done, she employed yet another skill to wipe the maid’s memory of the sudden ambush and left. When the maid woke up, she was drowsy but couldn’t remember anything.
Afterwards, Saden reverted to her Night Rider form and rode off on her shadow mare.

From the information she extracted, she learned about the sudden movements of the Malric family. They had left a few days ago and were now headed to the Althea Kingdom, specifically Raden City, one of the major trading hubs in the kingdom.
This puzzled Saden, as she knew they should be heading to Vastport City, where the auction would take place in less than three weeks.
She knew Darren and Melody planned to sell the herb, so why were they going to Raden City instead of Vastport?
She didn’t dwell on it for long. After leaving, she refrained from using the Realm of the Night to travel. Instead, she moved like an ordinary person, riding a terrifying-looking horse.
Two days later, she picked up the trail of people from the Malric family.
As soon as she did, she activated a skill all Night Riders possess: [Veil of Death].
It is a concealment skill that prevents the living from seeing them. Only the dead or those dying can perceive them. Of course, if one possesses an affinity for death energy, they can also see them.
She moved faster, steadily closing the gap. A few hours later, she came within range of a camp they had set up.
Sneakily, she made her way closer, scanning for the two individuals she was after. It didn’t take long to find Darren inside a tent discussing something with a few of his right-hand men.

"Young Master Darren, that bitch you mentioned—we couldn’t find her body, but we did find trails of blood. It’s likely a beast got to her first and feasted on the remains," reported a young man with razor-sharp eyebrows.
There are three others with him, and then there’s Darren, the heir of the Malric family.

"I guess you’re right. Though I never planned to kill her at first, she isn’t as weak-minded as her friend, who was easily manipulated, so she had to die, tragicly... I guess it all worked out," Darren said with a grin.

"The young master is indeed a genius in mind cultivation. Even the patriarch regularly praises you for finding all the best gems for the family," the razor-sharp-eyebrowed young man said shamelessly, sucking up to his young master.

"Thanks for the compliment, but if it hadn’t been for Kiln here, we wouldn’t have known she possesses that high-grade spirit root. Now, when we sell her, we won’t only be walking away with a bountiful harvest, but we’ll also be walking away with the Ten-Year-Old Gold Essence Mushroom."
The heir and his retainers laughed, looking in a certain direction.
Saden, who was listening in on their conversation, followed their gaze. She felt something wasn’t right, so she moved in that direction.
Truthfully, something indeed wasn’t right. When she came within range of a certain tent, she saw six Root Saints guarding it. Each of them was a powerful Root Saint, heavily armed and alert.
However, since none of them was dying or showed an affinity for death, she moved past them and glanced inside the tent.
There, she saw three girls in cages bound by runic-enforced chains. One of these girls was her sister, Melody, who was supposed to be basking in the sunlight with her one true love, Darren.
’Well, that was unexpected.’ He thought inwardly, but a cold glint appeared in her eyes.

She spent a few seconds inside the tent looking at the three caged ladies, and then she moved back and sped away from the camp. Once she was far enough, she shifted to her human form and sighed deeply.
A guilty look appeared in her eyes, forcing her to let out another sigh.
"So, she didn’t betray me... she was forced to betray me," Saden murmured, a cold glint flashing through her eyes.
Her mind replayed the times she had spent with Melody—precious moments she had spent with her. She cherished them all even today, despite the betrayal that had once pierced her heart.
Melody was the most cheerful person she had ever known. She was so full of life that even when things weren’t going well for them, she would always find a way to cheer her up.

It was why, when she betrayed her, she couldn’t believe it herself. She asked why a couple of times, but Melody only looked at her with no hesitation in her eyes. Back then, she was so shocked that she made up her mind to kill her.
But now, seeing things from a new perspective, it appeared Melody was that cold due to being controlled mentally.
"But how come I never noticed it?" She clenched her fists. She spent most days with Melody, so how come she never suspected she was being controlled mentally?
She sighed again and chose to focus...
The events she had just discovered were clearly something that made her immediately come up with two solutions, each for a different mission.
The first was to kill every last one of the cohort heading to Raden City. The second was to investigate just how deep this human trafficking went within the Malric family.

It was clear from what she saw and overheard that the patriarch of the Malric Noble Family was aware of this, and thus, she wouldn’t let it slide. Of course, she would have to handle it in her free time with her captain’s permission, but she wouldn’t stop.
The fact that her sister was manipulated to that extent pissed her off...
"You know, sometimes you have to stand back and see things from a different perspective before making a decision. You would be surprised how different things will play out from how you see them."
Just when she was seething, she heard someone speak from behind. Turning around, she saw her captain in his human form standing there.
Join The Discord Server: https://discord.gg/REJyJYqU

Thankfully, in her Night Rider form, she quickly reached the borders of the Varyndor Kingdom and reverted to her human form.
But instead of walking with an uncovered face, she donned a mask that obscured her eyes and pulled up a hoodie.
Moving swiftly, she soon found herself outside the mansion of the Malric noble family in Stonehaven.
She waited for something to happen, and an hour later, a maid attending to her duties passed by the spot where she was hiding.
Saden used a technique she had learned as a Night Rider to subdue the maid.
Then, she extracted the needed information using another skill that allowed her to only place her hand on the maid’s forehead.
When she was done, she employed yet another skill to wipe the maid’s memory of the sudden ambush and left.
When the maid woke up, she was drowsy but couldn’t remember anything.
Afterwards, Saden reverted to her Night Rider form and rode off on her shadow mare.
From the information she extracted, she learned about the sudden movements of the Malric family.
They had left a few days ago and were now headed to the Althea Kingdom, specifically Raden City, one of the major trading hubs in the kingdom.
This puzzled Saden, as she knew they should be heading to Vastport City, where the auction would take place in less than three weeks.
She knew Darren and Melody planned to sell the herb, so why were they going to Raden City instead of Vastport?
She didn’t dwell on it for long.
After leaving, she refrained from using the Realm of the Night to travel.
Instead, she moved like an ordinary person, riding a terrifying-looking horse.
Two days later, she picked up the trail of people from the Malric family.
As soon as she did, she activated a skill all Night Riders possess: [Veil of Death].
It is a concealment skill that prevents the living from seeing them.
Only the dead or those dying can perceive them.
Of course, if one possesses an affinity for death energy, they can also see them.
She moved faster, steadily closing the gap.
A few hours later, she came within range of a camp they had set up.
Sneakily, she made her way closer, scanning for the two individuals she was after.
It didn’t take long to find Darren inside a tent discussing something with a few of his right-hand men.
"Young Master Darren, that bitch you mentioned—we couldn’t find her body, but we did find trails of blood.
It’s likely a beast got to her first and feasted on the remains," reported a young man with razor-sharp eyebrows.
There are three others with him, and then there’s Darren, the heir of the Malric family.
"I guess you’re right.
Though I never planned to kill her at first, she isn’t as weak-minded as her friend, who was easily manipulated, so she had to die, tragicly...
I guess it all worked out," Darren said with a grin.
"The young master is indeed a genius in mind cultivation.
Even the patriarch regularly praises you for finding all the best gems for the family," the razor-sharp-eyebrowed young man said shamelessly, sucking up to his young master.
"Thanks for the compliment, but if it hadn’t been for Kiln here, we wouldn’t have known she possesses that high-grade spirit root.
Now, when we sell her, we won’t only be walking away with a bountiful harvest, but we’ll also be walking away with the Ten-Year-Old Gold Essence Mushroom."
The heir and his retainers laughed, looking in a certain direction.
Saden, who was listening in on their conversation, followed their gaze.
She felt something wasn’t right, so she moved in that direction.
Truthfully, something indeed wasn’t right.
When she came within range of a certain tent, she saw six Root Saints guarding it.
Each of them was a powerful Root Saint, heavily armed and alert.
However, since none of them was dying or showed an affinity for death, she moved past them and glanced inside the tent.
There, she saw three girls in cages bound by runic-enforced chains.
One of these girls was her sister, Melody, who was supposed to be basking in the sunlight with her one true love, Darren.
’Well, that was unexpected.’ He thought inwardly, but a cold glint appeared in her eyes.
She spent a few seconds inside the tent looking at the three caged ladies, and then she moved back and sped away from the camp.
Once she was far enough, she shifted to her human form and sighed deeply.
A guilty look appeared in her eyes, forcing her to let out another sigh.
"So, she didn’t betray me... she was forced to betray me," Saden murmured, a cold glint flashing through her eyes.
Her mind replayed the times she had spent with Melody—precious moments she had spent with her.
She cherished them all even today, despite the betrayal that had once pierced her heart.
Melody was the most cheerful person she had ever known.
She was so full of life that even when things weren’t going well for them, she would always find a way to cheer her up.
It was why, when she betrayed her, she couldn’t believe it herself.
She asked why a couple of times, but Melody only looked at her with no hesitation in her eyes.
Back then, she was so shocked that she made up her mind to kill her.
But now, seeing things from a new perspective, it appeared Melody was that cold due to being controlled mentally.
"But how come I never noticed it?" She clenched her fists.
She spent most days with Melody, so how come she never suspected she was being controlled mentally?
She sighed again and chose to focus...
The events she had just discovered were clearly something that made her immediately come up with two solutions, each for a different mission.
The first was to kill every last one of the cohort heading to Raden City.
The second was to investigate just how deep this human trafficking went within the Malric family.
It was clear from what she saw and overheard that the patriarch of the Malric Noble Family was aware of this, and thus, she wouldn’t let it slide.
Of course, she would have to handle it in her free time with her captain’s permission, but she wouldn’t stop.
The fact that her sister was manipulated to that extent pissed her off...
"You know, sometimes you have to stand back and see things from a different perspective before making a decision.
You would be surprised how different things will play out from how you see them."
Just when she was seething, she heard someone speak from behind.
Turning around, she saw her captain in his human form standing there.

chapters.title: Chapter 187: Unexpected Revenge (2)
paragraphs: Saden looked at her captain, who was just standing there. Of course, she could tell he had been there for a couple of hours but only now chose to reveal himself.
"Have you known about the true nature of her betrayal?" she asked.
"Yes. I saw it the day she stabbed you in the back. She didn’t do it of her own accord," Uncle Drew replied.
"I see," Saden nodded with a sigh. "Then is this some kind of test you have made for me?" she asked.

Uncle Drew smiled. "While this was unexpected, considering I never expected a noble family to be involved in human trafficking—well, it wouldn’t put it past them. But while this was unexpected, I can say this is a test, and you passed.

"Had you, out of anger, stormed in and killed everyone, which I know you can, it would have shown you are not ready to ride into the night. I wouldn’t have sent you back to hell for a couple of thousand years to reflect."
Saden’s body shuddered, but she composed herself. She had already been to hell, and she knew just how dangerous and painful it was...he would love not to step on them for a while.
"But now that you have proven yourself, you have to see it through to the end, and that will depend on how you want to handle this."
Saden turned and looked at the camp in the distance, smiling.
"When night comes, I will kill everyone and free the girls. Though Melody and I can’t go back to how we used to be, giving her her freedom is the least I can do..."
"If that is your decision, then go ahead. I will be here just in case you need my help."

Saden nodded and began making her plan. Though she had the power to command the night into day, that wouldn’t be much of an effect and would be too tiring. It was better to use the natural night, where she would be at her peak.
A few hours later, the moon smiled, signaling that night had come upon them.
She turned into her night rider form, and with a crossbow instead of her longbow in hand, she began moving through the night, her presence practically erased from the face of the world.
She made her way to the tent housing the four retainers of the aloof heir of the Malric Family.
They were drinking when she entered the tent. She looked at them, and a cold killing intent instantly enveloped the tent.
This alarmed the four, but before they could shout or even draw their weapons, she fired four arrows made from hellfire, burning their souls in an instant.
The hellfire that the Night Riders command has two forms: the Soul form and the Body form. Today, she used the Soul form, which harnesses soul energy.
Thankfully, she was linked to Kent, so while she didn’t know how her soul strength was quite high. She was no weaker than a Tier 4 soul cultivator...
...This allowed her to access a large enough pool of soul essence that she could harness for her attack.
Once she confirmed they were indeed dead by shooting four normal arrows into their heads, she left and headed toward Darren’s tent.
Upon arriving near the tent, she heard grunts coming from inside. She sneakily peeked in, and that was when she saw Darren using his hands to play with himself.

A disgusted look appeared on her face, and without knowing why she was feeling that way, she aimed her bow and fired an arrow that went through Darren’s hand and into his dick, inciting a painful cry from him.
Uncle Drew, observing the battle, shook his head at the unruly behavior of his second-in-command, one of the best archers in the Riders of the Night.𝐟𝚛𝕖𝚎𝕨𝗲𝐛𝚗𝐨𝐯𝐞𝕝.𝐜𝗼𝗺
Because of this cry, the six Root Saints heard it, and four immediately made their way toward Darren’s tent.
Saden was already hiding in wait. It took just three seconds, but the figures came within range, so she came out of concealment and blocked their advance.
When the four saw her, they immediately charged at her, but just as they closed in on her, she let loose four arrows that pierced their bodies, setting them on fire.
Saden wasn’t a Root Sage when she was a mere human; she was a level 2 Root Saint back then. But after she became a Night Rider, she received a boost, becoming a Level 2 Root Sage.
It couldn’t be explained, considering Uncle Drew had also gone from Root Master to a Root Sage at the peak, soon to become a Root Great Sage after he became a night rider.
So, while killing the four Root Saints was simple and looked easy, she was indeed stronger than them.
But still, killing all four that easily was the most unbelievable thing to anyone who might have witnessed it. Unfortunately, all those who saw it were her captain and the four who died.
Riding through the night, Saden moved toward the direction where the last two Root Saints were. It didn’t take long for her to drive an arrow or two through their hearts.
In the end, all six died, and she moved back to Darren, who was shedding tears of anguish.

Having your dick pierced by an arrow certainly isn’t ideal at all. But she had to resort to that, thanks to Saden hating him to the core. In the end, Darren could only keep screaming for ten whole minutes until she revealed herself, turning into her human form.
"You—A-aren’t you supposed to be dead?" Darren said through his pain, now mixed with shock and foreboding.
"No need to look shocked. You are not in the position to speak," Saden said, piercing an arrow through his thigh.
This caused Darren to scream even more loudly.
"I am going to ask a single question, and you must answer me truthfully, or the next arrow will be much more painful. Of course, I’ll make sure you die slowly and painfully."
Darren nodded like a baby. He wanted the pain to end...
"Why did you manipulate Melody into killing me?" Saden asked.
"That is because she has a Platinum-grade spirit root. I only found out thanks to one of my subordinates. But since she wouldn’t respond to my proposal, I had to get back at her somehow.

I initially wanted to make her my slave, but my father advised me to sell her instead. So, in order to not raise suspicion, I manipulated her into killing you and blamed it on you with the excuse that you killed her and ran off with a treasure we found."
"So all the bullshit about me being the fastest on the ground and being able to take the herb and escape was all your plan?" Saden glared at him, making Darren’s body shudder.

"I told you everything, please spare me... Please," Darren pleaded. He knew the Hunter’s Guild would investigate Melody’s disappearance when Saden noticed her disappearance and reported it, so he planned to blame Saden, who was destined to die after claiming the herb.
All he had to do was kill Saden, take Melody and the herb, and then report that Saden killed Melody and ran off with the herb they snatched from the demon mountains.
Everyone saw Saden and Melody run off with the herb, so he went with that plan. Saden is now a fugitive.
It was actually smart. It’s just too bad it ended poorly for him.
"In your next life, live a good one where you don’t turn into scum."
A green hellflame appeared in her hand and set Darren on fire. His scream filled the night, telling all creatures that the Night Riders were reborn and, soon, the night would be theirs to command.

chapters.title: Chapter 188: Mark Of The Night
paragraphs: The tent housing the three girls opened, and Saden walked inside. She was in her human form when she entered...
"Aria."𝓯𝓻𝒆𝙚𝒘𝓮𝙗𝓷𝒐𝓿𝙚𝒍.𝙘𝓸𝙢
The moment Melody set her sights on her, She shouted her name as tears began falling from her eyes. Perhaps due to her guilt, she quickly turned her face away, but the tears kept falling.
She had indeed killed her own friend—her sister—so the guilt was there and would forever remain despite her being influenced by someone else.
It was one of those things where you simply cannot forgive yourself that easily.
"It’s okay, Melody," Saden said, removing the chains around her arms and bringing her out of the cage. She did the same for the two ladies, who shed tears equally as they hugged each other.
Saden could tell they knew each other, so she didn’t focus on them and turned to her sister.

"No need to keep crying, Melody. I knew you weren’t in the right mindset when you did what you did. And hey, I’m still alive, so that should tell you I didn’t die, and you didn’t do anything bad," Saden said, making sure to free her from her guilt.
If she continued to live with this guilt, it would one day bring about her downfall, and while Saden could just turn a blind eye, Melody meant a lot to her.
They moved from one orphanage to the next, and at every turn, Melody was there for her. Even when things became hard for them, she was there. So she wouldn’t let her keep living in pain.
She was also angry, but not at Melody. She was angrier at the perpetrators of this enterprise—the Malric Noble Family.
"I am sorry, Aria. I can’t take back what I did, so all I can say is I am sorry," Melody said through her tears. Saden pulled her into a hug and gently wiped her tears away.
"You are my sister, Melody. You will always be my sister," Saden said, holding her close as Melody’s teary face remained buried in her chest.
After a couple of minutes, Melody managed to calm down. Saden then asked the two ladies where they wanted to go. In her human form, they only saw the beautiful lady who had saved them.
They had no idea she was, in fact, one of the most dangerous people in the world—a being of legend. Even Melody didn’t know the truth—and Saden wasn’t planning on telling her...not just yet.
It didn’t make sense to reveal it, especially since they would soon be going their separate ways.

"We don’t have anywhere to go. We were part of a mercenary family that was wiped out by the goons from the Malric Noble Family. We only survived because of the grade of our Spirit Roots," one of the ladies, Kalix, said.

"I am Kalix, the second daughter of the leader of the Green Flower Mercenary Group, and this is my retainer, Onyx. They killed our family and captured us because of my Diamond-grade Spirit Root and her Gold-grade Spirit Root."

One had to give it to Kalix—she knew how to use her wits to get what she wanted. She could tell the lady who rescued them might want to send them away, but she wasn’t about to risk falling into the hands of yet another bastard.

Just like Melody, Kalix was also manipulated and forced to betray her family. It wasn’t something she would have ever done willingly, but under mental manipulation, she had unwittingly caused the downfall of her family.
Saden looked at the two ladies and sighed. She then turned to Melody, who, despite being a few years younger than her, was old enough to attract the attention of many.
She knew that if she sent her out there, the chances of Melody getting into trouble were very high. But she also cannot take her along on her journeys.
Saden turned back to the two ladies and could tell that sending all three of them out into the world wouldn’t solve the problem.
’You can use the Mark of the Night on them. They are both promising individuals; they wouldn’t suffer as much as they would in this world. Plus, you can easily visit them whenever you want.’
Just as Saden was in a tight spot on what to do, Uncle Drew used their connection to offer her a way out.
’The Mark of the Night... I only have seven slots, and using three now... wouldn’t that weaken the Night Riders in the future?’ Saden asked.

’Not when we have a master who seems to have what it takes to change everything. For now, don’t worry about that. Send them away and let them grow. I’m sure in a few years, Master will be happy to add them to his legion, freeing up the three slots.
Plus, this is a much better way for you to understand how to have Night Fiends as retainers. Also, this is your chance to prove your usefulness to Master.’
Saden nodded.

Every Night Rider has seven slots, which, in a way, are akin to the slots of a summoner. These slots not only allow them to summon beings known as Night Fiends but also enable them to transform others into Shadow Fiends.
All Saden had to do was give them her mark, and she could send them to a place called the Plains of the Night. It’s a haven for Night Riders and their Night Fiends.
This place is a natural realm that, for centuries, even Celestial beings have failed to reach it. It is accessible only to Night Riders and those they deem fit to enter.

The Plains of the Night offer resources capable of sustaining life and fostering growth. However, the realm is not without its dangers. But surviving it is easy and depends mainly on the behaviour of those sent there.
They can grow stronger faster or become arrogant and die early. Either way, it’s a much better place than leaving them in a world where everyone is looking to make someone’s life miserable.

"I have a way to let you guys walk away from all this, but that will depend on whether you can trust me. I know we have just met, but to make sure you don’t go back to where you’ll get into the same trouble, you would have to trust me.
"So, do you ladies trust me enough to hear what I have to say?"
Saden asked, looking at the three ladies. They shared glances and nodded. She then went ahead and explained what she had in mind and how the Plains of the Night would be the safest place for them.
Strangely, she wasn’t even finished when all three of them eagerly agreed to go. They were deeply traumatized by what had happened, and if possible, they would love to remain there forever.
Saden nodded and then transformed into her Night Rider form. This momentarily startled the three ladies, but they quickly recovered as she gave them the Mark of the Night.
"I will be sending you away for now. I’ll come visit the moment I’m done with things here and have some free time."
The three ladies nodded.
Saden hugged them and then waved her hand, opening a portal made of night. They stepped through, and in the next instant, they found themselves in a lush, welcoming world.
The Plains of the Night was a breathtakingly beautiful place that could make anyone want to stay there forever.
Unbeknownst to Saden and the Night Riders, this world was destined to change everything they believed and understood.
After closing the portal, she returned to her captain.
"Master has given us a mission..."
They departed shortly after, heading toward their assignment—to kidnap one of the most tightly guarded individuals in Varyndor: Turyn, the heir of the Miller noble family.

Saden looked at the two ladies and sighed.
She then turned to Melody, who, despite being a few years younger than her, was old enough to attract the attention of many.
She knew that if she sent her out there, the chances of Melody getting into trouble were very high.
But she also cannot take her along on her journeys.
Saden turned back to the two ladies and could tell that sending all three of them out into the world wouldn’t solve the problem.
’You can use the Mark of the Night on them.
They are both promising individuals; they wouldn’t suffer as much as they would in this world.
Plus, you can easily visit them whenever you want.’
Just as Saden was in a tight spot on what to do, Uncle Drew used their connection to offer her a way out.
’The Mark of the Night...
I only have seven slots, and using three now... wouldn’t that weaken the Night Riders in the future?’ Saden asked.
’Not when we have a master who seems to have what it takes to change everything.
For now, don’t worry about that.
Send them away and let them grow.
I’m sure in a few years, Master will be happy to add them to his legion, freeing up the three slots.
Plus, this is a much better way for you to understand how to have Night Fiends as retainers.
Also, this is your chance to prove your usefulness to Master.’
Saden nodded.
Every Night Rider has seven slots, which, in a way, are akin to the slots of a summoner.
These slots not only allow them to summon beings known as Night Fiends but also enable them to transform others into Shadow Fiends.
All Saden had to do was give them her mark, and she could send them to a place called the Plains of the Night.
It’s a haven for Night Riders and their Night Fiends.
This place is a natural realm that, for centuries, even Celestial beings have failed to reach it.
It is accessible only to Night Riders and those they deem fit to enter.
The Plains of the Night offer resources capable of sustaining life and fostering growth.
However, the realm is not without its dangers.
But surviving it is easy and depends mainly on the behaviour of those sent there.
They can grow stronger faster or become arrogant and die early.
Either way, it’s a much better place than leaving them in a world where everyone is looking to make someone’s life miserable.
"I have a way to let you guys walk away from all this, but that will depend on whether you can trust me.
I know we have just met, but to make sure you don’t go back to where you’ll get into the same trouble, you would have to trust me.
"So, do you ladies trust me enough to hear what I have to say?"
Saden asked, looking at the three ladies.
They shared glances and nodded.
She then went ahead and explained what she had in mind and how the Plains of the Night would be the safest place for them.
Strangely, she wasn’t even finished when all three of them eagerly agreed to go.
They were deeply traumatized by what had happened, and if possible, they would love to remain there forever.
Saden nodded and then transformed into her Night Rider form.
This momentarily startled the three ladies, but they quickly recovered as she gave them the Mark of the Night.
"I will be sending you away for now.
I’ll come visit the moment I’m done with things here and have some free time."
The three ladies nodded.
Saden hugged them and then waved her hand, opening a portal made of night.
They stepped through, and in the next instant, they found themselves in a lush, welcoming world.
The Plains of the Night was a breathtakingly beautiful place that could make anyone want to stay there forever.
Unbeknownst to Saden and the Night Riders, this world was destined to change everything they believed and understood.
After closing the portal, she returned to her captain.
"Master has given us a mission..."
They departed shortly after, heading toward their assignment—to kidnap one of the most tightly guarded individuals in Varyndor: Turyn, the heir of the Miller noble family.
